programme.desc: Nina aiuta un ragazzo adottato in fuga che soffre di una rara malattia. Steve decide di interrompere le cure. Proust affronta il trauma dell’abbandono. Léo ufficializza il suo amore.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Durante una corsa benefica, Joana peggiora e sposa Steve in ospedale. Proust affronta finalmente sua madre. Nina rifiuta l’eredità e sceglie di restare infermiera. Ma un crollo allo stadio riporta l’emergenza.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Al primo giorno di tirocinio, Nina mette in dubbio la diagnosi del primario… che è anche il suo ex marito Costa. Il gesto riaccende tensioni in reparto e la rivalità con il dottor Proust.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Nina copre una giovane infermiera sorpresa con un chirurgo e viene creduta coinvolta. Quando un suo paziente cade in coma per un errore di dosaggio, Costa sorprende tutti difendendola.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Il padre di Nina viene ricoverato d’urgenza nel reparto che dirigeva. Restando al suo fianco, Nina assiste anche un uomo accusato di violenza domestica e si confronta con le proprie ferite familiari.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Nina si affeziona a una paziente obesa ignorata dal dottor Proust, mentre Léo si oppone a Costa per salvare una donna molto religiosa che rifiuta un intervento vitale.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Durante un’epidemia influenzale, Nina ritrova un’amica del liceo minacciata da paralisi. Intanto Léo cura un anziano diabetico deciso a sposarsi proprio il giorno in cui accusa un malore.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Nina affronta Proust per difendere un paziente terminale contrario alle cure invasive. Nel frattempo si teme una meningite per un altro ricoverato, mentre la vita privata di Costa complica tutto.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Dopo aver aiutato un parto in strada, Nina e Léo soccorrono madre e neonato in pericolo. In reparto però la caposala crolla sotto stress: malattia o burnout?

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Ultimo giorno di tirocinio: Nina attende il giudizio di Proust. La figlia Lily vive il suo primo stage in ospedale, mentre Léo affronta il ritorno dell’ex e segue un’atleta dai dolori misteriosi.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Mauro e Roberto indossano l'insolita veste di frati di un convento di clausura per condurre delle indagini. Nel convento, infatti, ha appena fatto ritorno una preziosa pala d'altare, da poco restaurata, e il priore, teme che qualcuno voglia rubarla.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Mentre Mauro e Germana sono in ospedale per ritirare i risultati delle analisi per sapere se potranno avere figli, un uomo prende in ostaggio un'infermiera e si chiude nella stanza dove suo figlio, in fin di vita, e' in attesa di un trapianto di cuore.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Una serie di tensioni latenti esplodono all'interno del X Tuscolano. Vittoria è offesa perchè Ingargiola non ammette i propri sentimenti per lei di fronte ai colleghi; Ugo desidera sposare Adele ma, allo stesso tempo, non vuole trasferirsi in Argentina.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Roberto scopre che Francesca e la piccola Mauretta sono state rapite. Poco dopo riceve una telefonata dai sequestratori che gli impongono di non rivolgersi a nessuno, costringendolo a muoversi in una situazione estremamente delicata e pericolosa.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Giulia e Mauro convocano la scientifica per far togliere i microfoni nascosti all'interno del commissariato. Qualcuno che ha libero accesso alle stanze del X Tuscolano è riuscito a piazzarli, forse proprio una delle persone più insospettabili.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: A cinque anni dall’omicidio del marito Ferdinando da parte del clan mafioso dei Tonnara, il commissario Giovanna Scalise lascia la Sicilia per trasferirsi a Roma. La sua nuova destinazione è il Commissariato X Tuscolano.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Quando il direttore di un magazzino di elettronica tenta il suicidio a causa dei debiti di gioco e delle minacce degli usurai che lo perseguitano, la squadra di Giovanna Scalise riapre la caccia a due criminali sfuggiti alla giustizia anni prima.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Gli agenti di polizia vengono chiamati d'urgenza da due cassiere che, dopo la chiusura del supermercato, hanno sentito dei rumori strani. Trovano invece un bambino solo e non identificato, che sta finendo di mangiare un barattolo di cioccolata.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Nina e Luca arrestano un ragazzo sorpreso a rubare un'autoradio. Lei lo rilascia subito dopo senza apparente motivo, perchè vuole risalire allo spacciatore che ha causato la morte del fratello Davide, dovuta ad overdose.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Un uomo penetra armato all'interno del commissariato e prende in ostaggio Nina e Roberto. Egli afferma di aver subito ingiustamente un processo dopo essere stato accusato di aver rubato 370 milioni dalla cassaforte dell'azienda in cui lavorava.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Proprio davanti agli occhi di Giovanna e della figlia Livia viene ucciso un rappresentante di occhiali, apparentemente incensurato. Manrico scopre che l'uomo aveva una relazione segreta con la moglie di un noto oculista di Roma, il dottor Ricci.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: L'ispettore Mauro Belli si imbatte per caso in una studentessa ventiquattrenne, Irene, che racconta di essere stata violentata dal proprio professore di filosofia politica, Viberti. Ma la polizia fatica a trovare prove convincenti.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Manrico si occupa di risolvere un caso di truffatori immobiliari mentre Ardenzi è impegnato con un caso di droga. La moglie di quest’ultimo abbondona la casa perché si sente ormai sola avendo scoperto di essere sterile nell’indifferenza del marito.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Dopo un assalto in banca i rapinatori vedono Tiberio, il padre dell'ispettore Belli e uno dei malviventi convince i complici a non ucciderlo. Tiberio dice al figlio di aver riconosciuto un suo ex-amico. Belli cercherà di convincerlo a costituirsi.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Ardenzi e Belli si imbattono in una ragazza, Natasha, alla quale una banda di albanesi ha rapito la figlia per costringerla a prostituirsi. Il commissario Scalise riceve un avviso di garanzia e deve abbandonare il commissariato.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Le dichiarazioni di un mafioso accusano il commissario Giovanna Scalise, ma gli agenti del decimo tuscolano sono convinti che la mafia voglia vendicarsi di lei cercando di screditarla e cercano di dimostrare l'innocenza del commissario.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Dopo alcuni pedinamenti, Parmesan e gli altri agenti scoprono che l'avvocato Loiacono invece di incontrare direttamente gli uomini della cosca, si serve di un intermediario per ricevere gli ordini dalla mafia.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Federico, il figlio del commissario Scalise, si sente male a scuola e presto si scopre che la responsabilità è colpa di un tatuaggio, fatto a scuola, il cui inchiostro contiene un derivato dell'LSD.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Due fratelli adolescenti, allievi di un centro sportivo e aspiranti calciatori professionisti, condividono lo stesso sogno. Uno dei due, talento promettente, viene trovato morto nel centro.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Il ritrovamento di uno scheletro nel bosco porta Boris e Constance a una donna cilena scomparsa 15 anni prima. Viveva con un uomo del posto e il loro giovane figlio, Thomas.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Durante un matrimonio, una giovane cameriera viene trovata uccisa. Boris e Constance analizzano le foto della cerimonia per ricostruire i suoi spostamenti e gli incontri della notte.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Una donna, da poco divorziata e madre di una bambina di due anni, viene trovata morta nella tenuta di famiglia appena ereditata. Un delitto che riapre ferite intime e legali.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Louise, 16 anni, viene trovata morta nel cassonetto del locale del padre. Alain Louvion, uomo ruvido e fuori dagli schemi, avverte il giudice Filiponi: se trova l’assassino prima della polizia, lo ucciderà.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Ingrid Montauban, 30 anni, splendida agente immobiliare di lusso, viene trovata morta nella piscina di una villa esclusiva che stava per vendere. Un delitto che scuote il mondo dorato dell’alta società.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Margot, 17 anni, promessa del nuoto francese, viene violentata negli spogliatoi del suo club poche settimane prima delle selezioni olimpiche. Con lei c’era solo il suo allenatore, David Grimm.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Victor Jacquet, 68 anni, potente direttore di una fabbrica tessile, viene assassinato. Il giudice Filiponi e la stagista Constance Meyer indagano su un uomo autoritario, pronto a cedere l’azienda al figlio.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Il palazzo di giustizia è sconvolto: la giudice Claire Delaunay viene trovata morta ai piedi di una scogliera. Non è suicidio. Filiponi prende il caso, nascondendo un segreto: era stato il suo amante.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Fabien Varelle, 31 anni, viene trovato morto in mare. Il giudice Filiponi e la stagista Constance Meyer sono convinti che non sia un incidente, ma un omicidio mascherato.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Constance segue un caso delicato che potrebbe rivelare un errore giudiziario: un uomo è in carcere da 7 anni per l’omicidio della moglie, ma si proclama innocente. Il dramma ha diviso profondamente la sua famiglia.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Uno studente di legge viene trovato morto nella sua stanza al campus universitario, dopo una festa di integrazione. Il giudice e Constance entrano nel mondo della facoltà, tra rivalità e tensioni sociali.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Una giovane donna crede di riconoscere l’aggressore della sua migliore amica, uccisa quattro anni prima. Il giorno dopo l’uomo viene trovato brutalmente assassinato. Le indagini portano a un cargo della marina mercantile.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Un giovane chef stellato, diventato celebre grazie a un talent culinario, viene trovato morto nella cella frigorifera del suo ristorante. Dietro il successo emergono gelosie e rivalità feroci.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Una giovane donna viene trovata morta in un vicolo, vicino a un graffito omofobo. Appartenente alla borghesia marsigliese, era in conflitto con la sua famiglia, influente nella regione.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Il corpo di una coreografa, appena arrivata a Marsiglia per rinnovare una prestigiosa compagnia di danza, viene ritrovato senza vita. L’indagine svela rivalità spietate nel mondo esigente del balletto d’opera.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Boris e Constance indagano su un caso delicatissimo: Sylvie Brunet è scomparsa insieme alla piccola Paloma, 5 anni. Il marito e il figlio denunciano la sparizione. I Brunet erano una famiglia affidataria da sempre.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Philippe Cazenave, primario di ginecologia all’ospedale La Timone di Marsiglia, crolla in Pronto Soccorso durante il giro mattutino. Le tracce di sangue sui vestiti indicano un omicidio.

programme.title: BYD Atto 2 ibrida 2026 in Italia
programme.desc: La BYD Atto 2 sarà ibrida con tecnologia DM-i dal 2026, disponibile anche in Italia.

programme.title: Eccentrica V12: Restmod Lamborghini 2025
programme.desc: Eccentrica reinterpreta la Lamborghini Diablo con un restmod che unisce passato e futuro. Dotata di un V12 ottimizzato e tecnologie avanzate, offre un'esperienza di guida unica e personalizzata.

programme.title: Mercedes GLC Elettrica 2026: 305 km in 10 min
programme.desc: Esplora la nuova Mercedes GLC 2026: un SUV elettrico innovativo con 490 CV, fino a 715 km di autonomia e ricarica ultraveloce. Scopri il design, l'Hyperscreen e le prestazioni su strada.

programme.title: Moto ferme? Paghi l'assicurazione
programme.desc: Moto ferme in box? Dal 2026 si paga l'assicurazione. Scopri le deroghe per i rottami e le nuove polizze stagionali. Attenzione ai tranelli del D.Lgs. 184/2023.

programme.title: Chery: i brand e arrivo in Italia
programme.desc: Esplora i brand di Chery, da Omoda a Lepas, e scopri i modelli che potrebbero arrivare in Italia. Un viaggio nel museo Chery per capire la crescita del colosso automotive cinese.

programme.title: KTM 990 RC R: versatilità e potenza
programme.desc: KTM ritorna nel segmento sportivo con la 990 RC R, una moto che combina prestazioni in pista con usabilità su strada, grazie al motore LC8c e una ciclistica avanzata.

programme.title: VW Golf R: Potenza e Efficienza
programme.desc: La VW Golf R unisce potenza e comfort con varie modalità di guida. Scopri come si trasforma da Golf rilassata a bolide sportivo. Efficace, versatile, non più solo un giocattolo.

programme.title: Traction Control Ducati Desmo450 MX
programme.desc: Provata la Ducati Desmo450 MX, prima moto da cross di Borgo Panigale, nel nuovo 04Park di Faenza, con campione Tony Cairoli. Scopri come va nel nostro test.

programme.title: Kia Stonic 2026: Pro e Contro
programme.desc: Scopri la Kia Stonic 2026: motore 1.0 mild hybrid, design moderno, interni avanzati. Ideale in città, ma con limiti in autostrada. Prezzi da 22.800 a 30.750 euro.

programme.title: Nuova BMW R12 GS: Bomba o Fake?
programme.desc: La nuova BMW R12 GS è all'altezza delle aspettative? Testata a fondo, si è rivelata maneggevole e potente. È una vera moto d'avventura con ottima manovrabilità, ma con un prezzo elevato.

programme.title: CABERG TANAMI: Crossover o Endurona?
programme.desc: Scopri il casco Caberg Tanami, ideale per crossover ed endurone. Analizziamo i suoi pro e contro in un viaggio nel basso Garda.

programme.title: Aprilia RS 660 Factory vs Standard: Test
programme.desc: Mettiamo alla prova la nuova Aprilia RS 660 Factory in pista a Modena per valutare gli aggiornamenti tecnici rispetto alla versione standard e scoprire se regna nel segmento sportivo.

programme.title: Tucano Urbano Airscud: Recensione
programme.desc: Airscud Flex di Tucano Urbano: protezione e comfort. Tecnologia avanzata con sensori e algoritmi per sicurezza ottimale. 5 modalità di guida per ogni esigenza.

programme.title: Segreti del Nightliner con Lacuna Coil
programme.desc: Scopri il mondo del Nightliner, il lussuoso bus delle rockstar che ospita artisti come i Lacuna Coil, con comfort e sicurezza per viaggiare come a casa durante i tour europei.

programme.title: Aprilia SR GT 400: scooter per motociclisti
programme.desc: Testato in Liguria, l'Aprilia SR GT 400 offre un'esperienza dinamica con parabrezza regolabile e un motore potente. Ottimo rapporto peso-potenza e sicurezza avanzata su strade bagnate.

programme.title: Test Yamaha R7 2026 novita
programme.desc: La Yamaha R7 2026 si rinnova con ergonomia rivista, design aggiornato ed elettronica evoluta con IMU a 6 assi, ride by wire e controlli dedicati per strada e pista.

programme.title: Nuova Santa-Cruz Bullit: Il Nostro Test
programme.desc: Test della nuova Santa Cruz Bullit e-MTB con sistema a quattro leveraggi. Motore Bosch, geometria aggressiva e sospensioni FOX per discese veloci e stabili, ma batteria da 600Wh limitata.

programme.title: Test Raymon Trailray 170 E-MTB
programme.desc: Testiamo la Raymon TrailRay 170: eMTB enduro da 4799€, sfida le top con 170mm di escursione. Scopri pregi, difetti e se vale davvero la pena!

programme.title: 50 anni di Golf GTI Edition 50
programme.desc: Volkswagen celebra i 50 anni della sigla GTI con la Golf Edition 50. Trazione anteriore, 325 CV e un differenziale elettronico la rendono una hot hatch pura e affascinante in pista.

programme.title: Toyota Urban Cruiser 2026: solo elettrica
programme.desc: Toyota Urban Cruiser debutta come SUV elettrico, progettato con Suzuki. Provato a Madrid, offre due batterie, accelerazione veloce, e ricarica rapida. Arrivo previsto fra fine 2025 e inizio 2026.

programme.title: Cannondale MOTERRA SL: la E-MTB ideale
programme.desc: La nuova Moterra unisce guida autentica e performance bilanciate. Ideale per chi cerca equilibrio tra potenza e leggerezza.

programme.title: Patenti 2026: Novità e Cambiamenti
programme.desc: Nuova patente digitale nel 2026: 8 ore guida obbligatorie, limiti neopatentati 105 CV, 15 anni validità. Controlli severi per over 65 e regole UE aggiornate.

programme.title: Recensione CGM 136 RNA: Jet completo
programme.desc: Scopri il casco Jet CGM 136 RNA, ideale per uso urbano e extraurbano. Leggero, con visiera ampia e interna fumè, offre comfort e versatilità. Guarda il video per tutti i dettagli!

programme.title: Il Globo e il Muro della Morte
programme.desc: Nico Cereghini esplora l'incidente del globo della morte e riflette sulle acrobazie nei luna park, omaggiando i Bettoschi e il loro muro della morte.

programme.title: I 10 migliori affari di Pernat
programme.desc: A casa di Pernat a Genova, si discutono i 10 affari migliori legati ai suoi piloti come Capirossi e Rossi e gli attuali ingaggi in MotoGP. Tra le trattative: Capirossi, Gramigni e Simoncelli.

programme.title: Dongfeng MAGE: SUV Full Hybrid
programme.desc: Dongfeng Mage HEV E3: SUV fastback con tetto panoramico e fari LED. Dentro: pelle, display 13,2”. Motore ibrido 245 CV, cambio intelligente. Consumi 5,7 l/100 km. Prezzo: 32.450€.

programme.desc: Il focolaio di una malattia porta a galla tristi ricordi per Patsy, mentre Suor Winifred è costretta a rivedere i suoi pregiudizi occupandosi di una futura mamma.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Serie 5, Episodio 4
programme.desc: Le pressioni della moderna Gran Bretagna raggiungono Poplar sotto forma di un distaccamento ospedaliero, mentre un parto difficile solleva delle questioni morali per Suor Julienne.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Serie 5, Episodio 5
programme.desc: Il passato della neomamma Roseanne continua a tormentarla, creando scompiglio nella vita della sua famiglia, mentre una ferita alla schiena costringe Violet ad affidare il suo negozio a Fred, con conseguenze impreviste.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Serie 5, Episodio 6
programme.desc: Una serie di violenti attacchi alle donne getta nel terrore Poplar e ha un impatto diretto sui residenti di Nonnatus House.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Serie 5, Episodio 7
programme.desc: Il dottor Turner si prepara al cambiamento con l'introduzione della pillola contraccettiva, mentre Patsy cerca di aiutare una donna che vive su una chiatta ed è decisa a partorire nella sua comunità.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Serie 5, Episodio 8
programme.desc: Poplar è sconvolta dalla rivelazione della causa dei difetti di nascita occorsi di recente, mentre Nonnatus House è devastata da una tragedia che la riguarda da vicino.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Episodio 1
programme.desc: Nella primavera del 1957, Jenny Lee, appena diplomata levatrice, giunge nell'East End di Londra per iniziare la carriera.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Serie 1, Episodio 2
programme.desc: Jenny Lee inizia a lavorare. Nel frattempo, arriva alla Nonnatus House anche Chummy. Un incontro fortuito con Mary, una giovane fuggiasca incinta, obbliga Jenny a considerare un lato oscuro della vita finora a lei sconosciuto.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Serie 1, Episodio 3
programme.desc: Jenny viene trasferita per alcune settimane della Squadra Levatrici del quartiere per fare esperienza di prassi comunitaria. Durante i suoi turni assiste Joe, un gentile soldato anziano, con cui stringe amicizia.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Serie 1, Episodio 4
programme.desc: Una neonata fatta recentemente nascere da Jenny, viene rubata dalla carrozzina. La famiglia è molto preoccupata e la comunità locale le si stringe intorno andando alla ricerca della bimba.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Serie 1, Episodio 5
programme.desc: Per una volta, Jenny si ritrova a gestire non l'inizio di una vita, ma la fine. Quando a Frank, fratello di Peggy, l'addetta alle pulizie della Nonnatus House, viene diagnosticato il cancro, Jenny e le suore dovranno prendersi cura di lui.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Serie 1, Episodio 6
programme.desc: Suor Monica Joan viene ritrovata mentre gira senza meta lungo i moli e viene riportata alla Nonnatus House dalla Polizia. Quest'avventura avrà ripercussioni sulla sua salute: soccomberà alla polmonite.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Serie 2, Episodio 1
programme.desc: Si avvicina il Natale, e a Poplar le levatrici della Nonnatus House sono più indaffarate che mai. Quando un neonato abbandonato viene ritrovato sui gradini del convento, la comunità si offre in aiuto per cercare la madre.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Visibility Zero
programme.desc: In 1993, the Amtrak Railroad experienced the deadliest train crash in United States history when the Sunset Limited derailed while crossing Alabama's Big Bayou Canot bridge. 47 passengers and crew were killed; scores more were injured.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hack Attack
programme.desc: A mysterious computer crash pushed a thriving manufacturing company to the brink of collapse, jeopardizing hundreds of jobs. Forensic investigators had to determine if the crash was the result of a computer defect, human error, or sabotage.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Road Rage
programme.desc: Police investigate a discarded sleeping bag containing bloody sneakers and a purse, which eventually leads to the body of a young woman. A mark found on the victim's body enables police to track the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hunter or Hunted
programme.desc: A woman is killed while walking her dogs in the woods. Since she has no enemies and her husband has an alibi, police assume it's a hunting accident — until they find a strange letter, allegedly written by the woman before her death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: In Harm's Way
programme.desc: An Alaskan police officer finds a woman's body while on routine patrol of a public park. During the autopsy, the medical examiner preserves the portion of her rib cage which sustained the fatal wound.

programme.title: Forensic Files: No Corpus Delicti
programme.desc: A woman disappears without a trace. Even though foul play is suspected, the leads don't pan out and the trail turns cold. Twenty years would pass before police are able to link a clump of hair discovered in an isolated area with the missing woman.

programme.title: Forensic Files: News at 11
programme.desc: When a talented television news anchor is shot to death outside her home, it appears to be a crime of passion perpetrated by an obsessed fan.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Burning Desire
programme.desc: Investigators sift through the ashes of a fire which killed a 40-year-old woman. The fire appears to have been started by an unattended cigarette. On closer look, forensic scientists discover the cause was far more complicated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cloak of Deceit
programme.desc: For seven years, a trio of men robbed one bank after another. They always got away before the police arrived and they left no evidence behind. But the way they stood and the clothes they wore told a story that could be read by forensic scientists.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bad Medicine
programme.desc: A young woman suddenly becomes critically ill, eventually leaving her unable to walk. A bone marrow test reveals the cause: arsenic poisoning. Investigators must determine if the poisoning was caused by groundwater contamination or something sinister.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Stick 'Em Up
programme.desc: Residents of Noel, Missouri were stunned to learn that their bank had been robbed and the bank president was missing. His body was later found floating in a lake, securely bound to a chair with duct tape.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Head Games
programme.desc: A young couple decided to celebrate their first wedding anniversary with a camping trip to Mount Hood. During the trip, the husband was shot and killed. Later, his wife told two different versions of the events which led to his death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Making the Collar
programme.desc: The body of 16-year-old Leanne Tiernan was discovered nine months after she disappeared. Forensic scientists found clues that painted a virtual portrait of her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Financial Downfall
programme.desc: A beautiful young woman falls to her death from a cliff overlooking the ocean. Initially, investigators think it was a tragic accident. But after a forensic examination, police uncover a very different picture of what happened.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Haunted by the disappearance of her mother, a young woman undertakes an investigation of her own. In her mother's diary, she discovers a dark family secret that might explain the disappearance.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Over a Barrel
programme.desc: California police had several suspects in the robbery and brutal murder of an elderly couple. Ten years later, a determined forensic scientist used material from a dentist's office to uncover ballistic evidence that had been overlooked.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pinned by the Evidence
programme.desc: After a street fight takes the life of a national wrestling champion, police must determine if he was killed in cold blood or in self-defense.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cries Unheard
programme.desc: A 19-year-old woman was found dead in her car; the scene had been staged to make murder appear to be suicide. During their investigation, police discovered the victim was involved in a love quadrangle, giving several people a motive to kill her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Buried Treasure
programme.desc: A man disappears one year to the day after beginning an affair with his friend's wife. 15 years later, with the help of a metal detector, police find evidence that would prove what had happened and who was responsible.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Badge of Betrayal
programme.desc: When the body of a young woman is found under an isolated highway ramp, a unique fiber on the victim's clothing leads San Diego police straight to the most unlikely of killers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Matrimony
programme.desc: A go-go dancer told her family she needed to get away for a while and then she simply disappeared. Investigators were suspicious, because she took neither her car nor her clothes. 20 years later, her family received a call that changed everything.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Muddy Waters
programme.desc: A Colorado hunter is the victim of a well-planned crime. Investigators suspect two weapons and two killers. But forensic evidence points them in a different direction — one much closer to home.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Point of Origin
programme.desc: In 1984, California firefighters battled ten arson fires in three weeks. When cigarettes and a scrap of paper connected the case to similar fires further north, the hunt was on for a dangerous pyromaniac.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seeds for Doubt
programme.desc: In 2002, a small community in upstate New York was devastated when Patty Wlasiuk died in a truck accident. But burdock seed pods found in her hair and on her clothes indicated that this was no accident — it was cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Saving Face
programme.desc: When a woman disappeared without a trace, there were two possible explanations: kidnapping or murder. Careful investigation, a forensic artist and DNA profiling enabled police to find a single suspect, who was known to prey upon vulnerable women.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Northern Exposure
programme.desc: Alaskan hikers discover a body wrapped in sheets which were edged in orange stitching. Investigators find a tuft of red carpet fibers clinging to the sheet — threads of evidence which lead them straight to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Silk Stalkings
programme.desc: Prompted by news of a flight attendant's brutal murder, the son of a previous victim contacts police. Both murders have similar MOs, and biological evidence proves that these were serial killings.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fishing for the Truth
programme.desc: A two-man shrimp boat sinks when a fast-moving, violent storm strikes the Louisiana coast. The captain drowns, but the deckhand is rescued fourteen hours later. The crewman is hailed as a hero — until the captain's body is discovered.

programme.title: Forensic Files: For Love or Money
programme.desc: When a wealthy real estate tycoon goes missing, it appears to be foul play. In his will, he leaves instructions in case he should die under violent circumstances — which were carried out after a hiker comes across his bullet-ridden skull.

programme.title: Forensic Files: South of the Border
programme.desc: The murder of an American tourist in a Mexican resort draws law enforcement resources on both sides of the border. At first glance, the motive appears to be robbery, but careful analysis of the forensic evidence points to something more sinister.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Stake-Out
programme.desc: Police are led on a wild goose chase when the wife of a prominent banker is kidnapped. An entomologist's unexpected discovery leads to a new suspect — and the realization that ordinary office equipment can leave extraordinary clues.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Walking Terror
programme.desc: A neighbor watched as a man stabbed his wife, pushed her into the swimming pool and held her head under water. The husband, however, had no recollection of the crime. A jury would have to decide between evidence and the mysteries of the mind.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Marked for Life
programme.desc: It would take 46 years, handwriting analysis and new fingerprint technology to solve the 1957 murders of two California police officers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Plastic Puzzle
programme.desc: A man riding a bicycle was fatally injured in what police believed to be a hit-and-run accident. Tiny clues found at the scene created a picture of the vehicle which struck him and led police to its driver.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Up in Smoke
programme.desc: When an elderly couple died in a suspicious house fire, their son became the prime suspect. Investigators turned to forensic science to determine if the fire had been set deliberately, or if it was an unfortunate accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Soiled Plan
programme.desc: Police instituted an intense search when the mother of two young children went missing. Twenty years after her body was found, new technology recontextualized old evidence and pointed directly to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Headquarters
programme.desc: When hunters reported finding a skull in a Texas canyon, police immediately began an investigation. With a forensic artist's reconstruction, police eventually learned the victim's identity. Now all they had to do was find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: One for the Road
programme.desc: A married couple decided to escape the cold of winter with a mini-vacation in Key West. The wife went missing and police searched every square inch of the island; they found nothing but a pair of sandals which might have belonged to her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Army of Evidence
programme.desc: A mother of two young children was found dead in her bedroom. Her death was ruled a suicide — but when investigators learned she had almost died in a house fire three years earlier, they decided to take another look at the evidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shear Luck
programme.desc: In 1991, when the wife of a serviceman was brutally murdered in the Philippines, investigators had to reassemble a tiny computer disk that had been cut to pieces in order to find the killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Stranger
programme.desc: The body of a young woman found burned in a truck launched a manhunt to find her killer. When more bodies began to turn up across the country, the FBI believed the cases were linked. Investigators had a suspect. They just couldn't find him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Manhunt
programme.desc: A killer was on the loose in one of America's most popular tourist destinations. Armed and desperate, he evaded law enforcement at every turn. As the Fourth of July weekend quickly approached, thousands of people became potential targets.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Abroad
programme.desc: Beginning in 1990, Europe found itself in the clutches of a serial killer. He became an international outlaw, hopping from country to country to evade capture and to kill again.

programme.title: The FBI Files: .22 Caliber Killer
programme.desc: In Buffalo, New York, a sniper targeted African-American men. He held a city hostage, and threatened to ignite a racial powder keg. And it looked like others might be following his bloody example.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Held For Ransom
programme.desc: Wealth has its rewards, but it also brings its dangers. Kidnapping is one of them. No ordeal is more horrifying for a family than to have a child taken.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programme.desc: A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dead Run
programme.desc: In Pennsylvania, an inmate escaped with the help of his female accomplice. Following a trail of fraudulent credit card receipts and deaths, authorities track the pair, but always find themselves one step behind.

programme.title: The FBI Files: First and Kennedy Street Crew
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, Washington, D.C., became the murder capital of the nation. Few were left untouched by gang violence, which was ignited by the drug trade. By 1994, that violence would strike at the very heart of law enforcement.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Coffee Shop Murders
programme.desc: At a coffee shop in Washington, DC, three employees were shot to death. Evidence at the crime scene pointed in many different directions. Was this a hate crime, a robbery gone wrong or an act of cold-blooded vengeance?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dishonored
programme.desc: Shirley Russell was determined enough to reach the rank of Captain in the United States Marine Corps. When this officer turned up missing, her colleagues refused to believe she had gone AWOL. It was unclear whether Captain Shirley Russell was alive.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Evil Intent
programme.desc: Drops of blood and a torn screen were all that's left to tell authorities what happened to a woman in Indiana. The 21 yr. old victim was taken from her home on a spring morning. She appeared to have no real enemies, there was no clear motive.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: When Seconds Count
programme.desc: On July 2nd 1994, a 12-year-old girl was abducted from her home in northern California. The FBI knows to act fast, search wide, enlist volunteers. But as the hours slipped by, agents also realized their chances for recovering her alive grew slim.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Vanished
programme.desc: A daring kidnapping and a bizarre ransom note baffled Mississippi authorities. The victim was the wife of a wealthy businessman. A list of 12 names and a few drops of blood were the only clues to her fate.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Unlawful Flight
programme.desc: In Alabama, two desperate criminals fled the custody of a local deputy. Eluding authorities, they made their way across the country in a wave of car theft, abduction, and murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly intentions
programme.desc: When abduction turns to murder, forensic science is the only key to finding justice for the victims of a kidnapper's deadly intentions.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written In Bone
programme.desc: At the scene of a murder, sometimes the victim provides the only clues to their killer. Forensic anthropologists use skeletal remains to decipher the clues written in the bones.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead Men Do Talk
programme.desc: Profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts and the procedures they use to solve murders and other mysteries in minutes or centuries after they happen.

programme.title: The New Detectives: In The Line of Fire
programme.desc: Bombers, snipers, spree killers: some people don't care who they kill, they just want to hurt innocent people.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Marked For Death
programme.desc: Sometimes killers are careful to leave no fingerprints behind. But methods of the murder itself can leave a lasting impression on police, especially when the tools (or weapons) of a killer's trade leave an innocent victim marked for death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bloodlust
programme.desc: For homicide investigators, it's a race against time as they track their deadliest foe: a serial killer for whom killing is the only way to feel alive.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Random Targets
programme.desc: Most victims of multiple murderers are meticulously chosen because of a mutual connection with the killer or because they match an intricate set of criteria that fits the killer's MO.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial By Fire
programme.desc: At a crime scene, anything left behind or seemingly out of place is considered a clue. But a fire can extinguish everything in its path challenging forensic investigators at every turn and making each arson a trial by fire.

programme.title: The New Detectives: True Crime
programme.desc: They know as much about crime as any crime fighter, or any criminal. They're the crime writers, and through their eyes we see murder most foul.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trails of Evidence
programme.desc: In criminal investigations, a simple clue can provide the missing link by placing a suspect at a crime scene. Dirt left on shoes, tires or clothes, or even a tiny piece of plastic can pinpoint a crime scene.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Material Witness
programme.desc: Lies and deceit can often throw investigators off the trail of justice. But when hard evidence contradicts a killer's story, police must use the clues to piece together the truth.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Unlikely Sources
programme.desc: Some of the best clues come from the least likely places. Baffling crimes have been solved and criminals betrayed through evidence provided by insects, beer bottles, and other seemingly meaningless objects.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Camera Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Photography: Forensic photographers are among the first people at a crime scene, capturing vital clues on film. What do the cameras capture that can't be seen first-hand, and who are the men and women who analyze the camera's clues?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Trust
programme.desc: Poison is the subtlest form of death, and investigators must see through unusual circumstances to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Family Plots
programme.desc: Every family has its secrets, and sometimes blood relations lead to bloodshed. When murder becomes a family affair, investigators must turn to forensics to uncover family plots.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murderous Attraction
programme.desc: In Columbus, Ohio, a woman is found shot in the head. The death is ruled a suicide, but something is not right and detectives refuse to let the matter rest.

programme.title: The New Detectives: For Love Or Money
programme.desc: Every family has its secrets, and sometimes blood relations lead to bloodshed. When money is the motive, murder can rip at the very foundation of marriage and family.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Passage in Time
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension investigate Big Condo Studios in Liverpool, UK. Located in one of the most haunted cities in the world and believed to be haunted by some very playful spirits. Will they join the team on their investigation tonight?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Poltergeist House
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension investigate a Poltergeist haunting a homeowner who is a wits end. Poltergeistal activity in the home is terrorizing the tenant and paranormal investigators Bex and Sean are about to start the exorcism of this demonic entity away for good.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Whitby Hall
programme.desc: Built in the early 1800s, Whitby Hall used to be an administrative center and now stands as a public park and arts center. It has never before been investigated, but staff have reported many noises and presences among them.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Razor Ruddock's Home
programme.desc: We visit the home of Soccer legend Neil "Razor" Ruddock which seems to be haunted. Is it his home specifically? Or are these ghosts attached to him?

programme.title: Past Hunters: Mill Street Barracks
programme.desc: Built in 1861 Mill Street Barracks is steeped in rich history. It has accommodated many branches of the armed forces throughout its life. Like many other barracks it has also been used as a morgue making it a prime location for the supernatural.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Stranger in the Blitz
programme.desc: Damaged during the blitz, the location the team investigate was a former war hospital for the injured and wounded, based in Liverpool, UK.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Celebrity Special - The Black Horse in Pluckley Village
programme.desc: Bex and Sean are joined by reality TV star Charlie Doherty in the most haunted village in the UK and investigate the most haunted pub in the UK, The Black Horse.
programme.sub-title: Celebrity Special - The Black Horse in Pluckley Village

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: The Piano Plays a Ghost Song
programme.desc: Following reports of loud voices and footsteps heard when no one else is around, staff seeing dark shadows fleeting through the empty corridors, to several pianos playing by themselves, Ghost Dimension head into Champness Hall.
programme.sub-title: The Piano Plays a Ghost Song

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Haunting of New Mills Art Theatre Part 1
programme.desc: The Ghost Dimension team travels to Derbyshire to investigate the New Mills Arts Theatre. This quirky little building has played host to many famous acts and world-renowned plays but has a little-known secret in that it's allegedly haunted.
programme.sub-title: Haunting of New Mills Art Theatre Part 1

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Haunting of New Mills Art Theatre Part 2
programme.desc: The Ghost Dimension Team is ready for act II at the New Mills Arts Theatre. With so much apparent activity happening at this unassuming theatre, the team just couldn't leave when so much more could happen.
programme.sub-title: Haunting of New Mills Art Theatre Part 2

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Haunted Weir Mill
programme.desc: The Ghost Dimension team visits Weir Mill, the oldest and most paranormally active mill in Stockport.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: The Old Glen and Milner Curse
programme.desc: The Ghost Dimension team heads to Shipley, West Yorkshire to investigate The Old Glen House Pub.
programme.sub-title: The Old Glen and Milner Curse

programme.title: Past Hunters: Bulkeley Hotel
programme.desc: The former home of Queen Victoria is now home to many spirits who have been seen by guests and staff. Witness the first ever formal documentation of the paranormal activities in the Bulkeley Hotel.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: House of Horror
programme.desc: Blackpool is iconic for ghosts and tonight, Sean and Bex investigate a horror attraction which appears to have attracted some very real spirits that are spooking its customers.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Long Lost Treasure at Jessops Old Mill and Auction House
programme.desc: The ghost dimension team visits Batley, West Yorkshire to investigate a location where it may not be the building that's haunted but the items that reside within.
programme.sub-title: Long Lost Treasure at Jessops Old Mill and Auction House

programme.title: Past Hunters: Blackpool Pleasure Beach
programme.desc: Blackpool Pleasure Beach is one of the most visited attractions in the United Kingdom. People visit it not only for the fun, but to also hopefully catch a glimpse of the many ghosts that haunt there.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo: Forgotten Souls of Errwood Hall
programme.desc: Sean heads to the Errwood Hall ruins in the Goyt Valley. It is said to be haunted by 3 spirits, and that it has its very own time slip. The investigation does not disappoint and although the hall is gone, the spirits remain.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Ghost in the Shower
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension investigate Waterloo Rugby Club and come into contact with a very mischievous spirit in the male showers! A ghost that scares away any female that dares to enter.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Drakelow Tunnels
programme.desc: The Drakelow Tunnels are a former underground military complexused mainly for storage. However, during the construction and running of this facility, 6 people are thought to have died.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I'm a Survivor, but I Can't Take This
programme.desc: Is Khadisa's boyfriend Chad cheating on her with her own sister? Will Maya's ex trust her and her current beau with their infant son?
programme.sub-title: I'm a Survivor, but I Can't Take This

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Your Kids Need Their Mom, But You Chose Him
programme.desc: Will Nadia and Woody's lie detector test results prove that they were negligent and deserved to lose custody of their children? Then, can Steve set the record straight about Josette's daughter?
programme.sub-title: Your Kids Need Their Mom, But You Chose Him

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: The 1,000th Episode!
programme.desc: On the 1,000th episode, we'll bring you all of the crazy confessions, explosive meltdowns, chair throws, funny moments and the heartfelt stories that have made this show special!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve Saw Right Through You
programme.desc: Today on Steve Wilkos, Maurice wants to prove to his girlfriend that he's faithful. Plus Chuanhtee says fed up with Ladi's cheating accusations! Watch as the truth is revealed!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Have Two Husbands
programme.desc: Jessica married Gian after a five-month relationship. With a baby on the way, everything seems to be going great for the couple, except Jessica is married to another man, Michael!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: An Explosive DNA Story
programme.desc: Teneal and Richard are telling different tales, each alleging the other is unfit to parent! The truth will come down to a lie detector test, and the results will be shocking!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve, I Can't Face The Truth.
programme.desc: Today Danny is finally ready to face the missing man in his life and get answers to lifelong questions. Steven offers a number of excuses for not seeing his son, but can he redeem himself?
programme.sub-title: Steve, I Can't Face The Truth.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Did You Murder My Daughter?
programme.desc: Two years ago, Latisha and her boyfriend were found shot to death in their car. Latisha’s mother Nancy believes her ex-husband Kenneth was involved. Who is responsible for their deaths?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Got a 14 Year Old Pregnant
programme.desc: Megan is 14 and pregnant with 19 year old Michael’s baby, but he doesn’t see any problems with this situation. Laurie, Megan’s mother, turns to Steve to help get through to her!
programme.sub-title: I Got a 14 Year Old Pregnant

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve, Get Him Out!
programme.desc: Kelly’s ex-husband Nikki continues to haunt her. He went to jail for killing her 2 week old son and is now dating her 18 year old daughter! Can Steve get Nikki out of their lives forever?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: A Mother in Denial
programme.desc: When ordinary people need help, Steve Wilkos is ready to answer the call. Watch as Steve helps ordinary people stand up for themselves and fight for what he believes in order to promote justice for all.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: A Mother's Rage
programme.desc: Three years later, Elizabeth still carries strong doubts about Manny's intentions with her family and her husband Rodney is caught in the middle. Is Manny innocent?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Mommy Hurt Me
programme.desc: Stephanie’s drug addiction led her to neglect and abuse her kids. Scott’s fiancée stepped up as a mother and Stephanie failed multiple drug tests, he doesn’t want her near the kids, but wants her to atone for her wrongs!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Who’s Hurting My Granddaughter?
programme.desc: Maria claims that her son’s ex Amy and her new boyfriend Brian are abusing and neglecting her granddaughter. But Amy says Maria is a racist and angry over raising her grandchild in a Hispanic home!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: What Happened to My Baby?
programme.desc: Baby Garrett died of an oxycodone drug overdose while in Sharon’s care. His mother Casey left him with Sharon so she could visit her husband Kenneth in the hospital. Who’s responsible?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Wait! Don't Read The Results Yet Steve...
programme.desc: Sharina thinks that Clarence is cheating on her because he’s always out late. Plus, Chrystal doesn’t want Earnie’s ex Tenyia to live with them just because she’s the mother of his child.
programme.sub-title: Wait! Don't Read The Results Yet Steve...

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Is My Husband the Abuser?
programme.desc: Joyia is desperate to keep her friend Stephanie from going back to her problematic ex Scott. But she still loves him! Will she have the strength to leave him?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve Outraged!
programme.desc: Jack is worried about his grandchildren because his daughter-in-law Carol has been negligent and hot-tempered. Then, Kendra explains why she suddenly put Corey’s baby up for adoption.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Did You Murder My Daughter?
programme.desc: Teenager Megan lives with her older controlling boyfriend Rick. Megan cannot attend school, find a job, or even eat without his OK! Can her aunt and Steve get through to her?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Did You Fake Your Pregnancies?
programme.desc: Dennis claims his ex-girlfriend Kendal keeps tied down with pregnancy lies! He wants to know if their daughter is even his! Will Steve’s DNA test results finally let them move on?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Results Revealed: Did She Cheat?
programme.desc: Justin is convinced that girlfriend Lainie has been cheating on him, and more importantly that he’s not the father of their child. But his own insecurities have led him to turn violent. Also, Steven doubts whether Ashley’s child is his.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: A Tragic Accident
programme.desc: Rebecca left her baby with fiancé James and his mother Adeline, only to discover that her baby was hospitalized. Rebecca suspects that James is responsible. Adeline blames her for the baby’s death!

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: What About Me?
programme.desc: På Speidis velværeanstalt går det rykter om at Kaitlynn er gravid. Brandon avslører sjokkerenede nyheter om forholdet. Familien Wahlers kamp for å slutte fred med familien Pratt, blir distrahert av mulige skjellsettende forandringer for egen del.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Timing Is Everything
programme.desc: Kaitlynn knekker nyheten om sin graviditet til Brody, men er urolig når han og Kris skal møtes på fristedet. Pratt- og Wahler-gjengen håndterer endelig feiden som har delt gruppen. Justin får lære viktigheten av å vedlikeholde kontakter.

programme.title: The Hills: New City, New Drama
programme.desc: Når Lauren Conrad må mestre både moteskolen, en krevende praktikantjobb og en uforutsigbar romkamerat som ødelegger for henne, forstår hun raskt at alt er stort i Los Angeles, også hennes egne problemer.

programme.title: The Hills: A Change of Plans
programme.desc: Når Heidi fikser et intervju for drømmejobben som får henne til å overveie å hoppe av skolen permanent, forstår Lauren at hun og Heidi kanskje har helt forskjellige mål.

programme.title: The Hills: An Unexpected Call
programme.desc: Teen Vogue sender Lauren på et oppdrag til New York City, men vel tilbake i L.A. venter det henne en stor overraskelse fra fortiden. Heidi skjønner at å jobbe med festreklamering ikke bare er en fest.

programme.title: The Hills: Lauren and Jason: Part 2
programme.desc: Da Jason, Laurens eksflamme fra Laguna Beach, dukker opp igjen i livet hennes, forstår hun at hun kanskje ikke er så ferdig med ham som hun trodde. Samtidig, i sin nye jobb, spør Heidi seg om det egentlig er verdt alt strevet.

programme.title: The Hills: Jason's Birthday
programme.desc: Lauren haster hjem fra en lang Teen Vogue-event for å være sammen med Jason på bursdagen hans, men kvelden blir ikke som forventet. Audrina ber Heidi om råd rundt hennes nyeste date, modellen og skuespilleren Danny.

programme.title: The Hills: Boyfriends and Work Don't Mix
programme.desc: Jason utvikler seg til å bli et forstyrrende moment i Laurens profesjonelle og akademiske liv. Heidi får endelig mulighet til å jobbe i nattklubbene, men tidspunktet kunne ikke ha vært dårligere.

programme.title: The Hills: Somebody Always Has to Cry
programme.desc: Det er gjengens første ferie i L.A. og ikke alle får det de ønsket seg. Et nyttårskyss skal vise seg å bli litt av en oppgave for Lauren, når Jason finner ut at hun fikk en uventet telefon fra en gammel flamme.

programme.title: The Hills: You Can't Just Be With Me?
programme.desc: Jason vil gjerne gjøre Laurens 20-årsdag spesiell, men når hun lyver for ham angående en jobb med mannelige modeller for et Teen Vogue-oppdrag, settes forholdet deres på prøve.
programme.sub-title: You Can't Just Be With Me?

programme.title: The Hills: Love is Not a Maybe Thing
programme.desc: Heidi bestemmer endelig at hun har opplevd nok dramatikk med Jordan. Lauren og Jason tenker på å gå et hakk videre.
programme.sub-title: Love is Not a Maybe Thing

programme.title: The Hills: Timing is Everything
programme.desc: Når Laurens harde jobbing under moteuken i L.A. fører til tidenes største karrieremulighet, føler hun seg dradd mellom jobben sin og kjæresten sin.

programme.title: The Hills: Out With The Old
programme.desc: Etter en vaklevoren sommer med kjæresten Jason, bestemmer Lauren seg for å gjøre det slutt og drar tilbake til Teen Vogue for å møte sin mindre glade sjef. Heidi får problemer med en fyr som både hun og Audrina dater.

programme.title: The Hills: When You Least Expect It
programme.desc: Lauren går på sin første date siden Jason, og blir satt på prøve på jobben når hun bes om å gjøre sitt første moteshow. Heidi har en livsavgjørende hemmelighet hun må fortelle om til kjæresten sin.

programme.title: The Hills: The Best Night Ever
programme.desc: Når Audrina dukker opp i Heidis bursdag uten invitasjon, forstår hun at Heidi ikke er villig til å tilgi og glemme. Lauren, som har bestemt seg for å konsentrere seg om jobben, blir forført av sjarmen til Brody, den nye typen i livet hennes.

programme.title: The Hills: Who Do You Trust?
programme.desc: Audrina forteller Heidi at Spencer er en lurendreier, men Heidi stiller seg tvilende - til hun ser det med egen øyne. Lauren fortsetter å lure på om hun er klar for et forhold.

programme.title: The Hills: One Big Interruption
programme.desc: Heidi tar en pause fra Spencer, men savner ham mer en hun trodde hun ville. Lauren må planlegge en Teen Vogue-middag, men distraheres når hun må hjelpe praktikanten Emily fra New York.

programme.title: The Hills: You Have Chosen
programme.desc: Når Lauren forteller Heidi hva hun egentlig syns om Spencer, må Heidi velge mellom bestevennen sin og kjæresten.

programme.title: The Hills: With Friends Like These...
programme.desc: Lauren forstår at hun ikke kan stole på bestevennene sine etter at Heidi spleiser Jen med Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: Enough Is Enough
programme.desc: Spencer ber Heidi om å flytte inn hos ham, men Heidi vet ikke hva hun skal gjøre, eller hvordan hun skal fortelle det til samboeren Lauren.

programme.title: The Hills: New Year, New Friends
programme.desc: Laurens 21-årsdag er full av overraskelser - Heidi og Audrina holder selskap for henne. Jen gjør et forsøk på å slutte fred med Lauren.

programme.title: The Hills: Apology Not Accepted
programme.desc: Lauren fyller 21 år og Heidi har store planer for bursdagsfeiringen. Men, rett før festen bestemmer Heidi seg for å fortelle Lauren om Spencers ide om at de skal flytte sammen.

programme.title: The Hills: Goodbye for Now
programme.desc: I sesongfinalen når spenningen sitt toppunkt når Heidi tar et endelig valg angående å flytte sammen med Spencer. Lauren går til Audrina for å fylle tomrommet etter bestevennen sin, og Whitney flyr til New York City til et intervju.

programme.title: The Hills: You Know What You Did
programme.desc: Lauren drar ikke til Heidi og Spencers innflyttingsfest da hun får høre at Heidi har spredd rykter om henne. Men når Lauren og Heidi støter på hverandre, begynner de å krangle verre enn de noen gang har gjort før.

programme.title: The Hills: Big Girls Don't Cry
programme.desc: Lauren og Heidi glir enda lenger fra hverandre når Spencer frir til Heidi. Audrina går inn for sitt forhold med en tidligere kjæreste, og Lauren drar tilbake til Laguna Beach for å rådføre seg.

programme.title: The Hills: Truth And Time Tells All
programme.desc: Lauren hjelper Audrina med å avgjøre om Justin er kjærestemateriale, men Audrina har allerede tatt sitt valg. Heidi forstår at å være forlovet ikke bare er lek og alskens moro.

programme.title: The Hills: Meet The Parents
programme.desc: Slik jeg ser det: Opplev dine yndlingsrealityskuespillere og yndlingssituasjoner - med en komisk vri. Alt og all, fra Lauren til Spencer - ingen eller ingenting er trygge for den ene skuespilleren som alene spiller hver eneste rolle i serien.

programme.title: The Hills: Rolling With The Enemy
programme.desc: Heidis omgangskrets minker når Spencer "slår opp" med Brody fordi han vanker med Lauren. Audrina vil at forholdet til Justin skal være offisielt, men han nekter å binde seg.

programme.title: The Hills: Second Chances
programme.desc: Lauren opplever et pust fra fortiden da hennes ekskjæreste Jason ringer. Heidi konkurrerer med kollegaen Elodie om en forfremmelse på jobben.

programme.title: The Hills: They Meet Again
programme.desc: Laurens følelser for Jason flammer opp igjen, men når de støter på Heidi og Spencer på en restaurant, er det mer som slår gnister. Heidis forfremmelse hos Bolthouse koster henne vennskapet med Elodie.

programme.title: The Hills: For Better Or Worse
programme.desc: Lauren får sjokk da hun får vite at Jason har en kjæreste, men Jason har en enda større overraskelse på lager. Heidi finner ut at Spencer ikke har fortalt sine foreldre om gifteplanene deres.

programme.title: The Hills: What Happens In Vegas...
programme.desc: Gjengen feirer Brodys bursdag i Vegas. Audrinas kjæreste Justin skaper problemer for hennes vennskap med Lauren. Lauren og Brodys tiltrekning til hverandre vokser.

programme.title: The Hills: What Goes Around
programme.desc: Jen Bunney forteller Lauren at Brody startet ryktene om henne, men Brody skylder på Spencer, og Heidi blir stående midt oppi det hele. Lauren ber Audrina om unnskyldning for å ha blandet seg i hennes og Justins forhold.

programme.title: The Hills: No More Mr. Nice Guy
programme.desc: Lauren begynner en ny romanse med en herremodell, men innser at hun fortsatt er glad i Brody. Spencer er redd for at Heidis nye jobb vil ta henne fra ham.

programme.title: The Hills: Stress And The City
programme.desc: Whitney og Lauren tar en tur til NYC for Teen Vogue, og Spencer henvender seg til Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: Young Hollywood
programme.desc: Whitney og Lauren er med i The Young Hollywood Party, og Heidi feirer sin 21-årsdag.

programme.title: The Hills: Forgive and Forget
programme.desc: Heidi og Lauren krangler nok en gang offentlig, noe som resulterer i at Heidi ber Lauren om unnskyldning for alt som har hendt. Audrinas forhold med Justin går ikke framover, men karrieren hennes hos Epic Records går så det suser.

programme.title: The Hills: With This Ring...
programme.desc: Lauren leker Kirsten Giftekniv når Whitney går på sin første date med sin personlige trener. Spencer er i mot Heidis planer om et eventyrbryllup, og det ender i en krangel som truer hele forholdet deres.

programme.title: The Hills: A Night At The Opera
programme.desc: Audrina tar Justin i å kysse en annen jente, og en endelig konfrontasjon rundt forholdet deres følger. Heidi sjokkeres av at Spencers søster starter en krangel med Lauren og Brody på en nattklubb.

programme.title: The Hills: Once a Player
programme.desc: Lauren mener at Brody er for mye av en playboy til at man bør ta ham alvorlig. Spencers søster forteller ham at Heidi i hemmelighet tviler på om de bør gifte seg.

programme.title: The Hills: When One Door Closes...
programme.desc: Lauren mottar noen spennende nyheter på Teen Vogue og Heidi trenger litt tid borte fra Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: Paris Changes Everything
programme.desc: Lauren får endelig dra til Paris, men drømmeturen blir nesten ødelagt da hun finner ut at Brody har funnet seg en ny. Spencer følger etter Heidi til Colorado for å vinne henne tilbake, men planen hans slår feil.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Welcome to the Peak
programme.desc: Ti realitekjendiser ankommer vinterlandskapet for å se om de kan finne sin neste for minglesesongen. Hva de ikke vet er at eksene deres kommer til å styrte inn som et snøskred.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Winter Un-Wonderland
programme.desc: Eksene til Callum og Nicole forårsaker skikkelig trøbbel i huset. En kjærlighetsforbindelse oppstår for et par og brytes raskt for et annet. En ny eks ankommer og den første 'Hot Date' blir belønnet.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Caught Red Velvet Handed
programme.desc: Daniel gjør et klossete forsøk på en kjærlighetsforbindelse. Varmen stiger i "Sauna of Secrets" for en utro singel. Den første eksen ises ut av sommrhuset.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: De Niall Is Not Just an Ex
programme.desc: Marlon får mange eksers oppmerksomhet og Adore er mindre glad for det. En sjarmerende overraskelse avbryter "the Hot Date".
programme.sub-title: De Niall Is Not Just an Ex

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Boo Years Eve!
programme.desc: "Sauna of Secrets" avslører et mysterie for Marlons eks. To singler slåss om den samme eksen. Tingene går varme under Ice Ceremony når en eks foretar et overraskende trekk.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: The Bird Has Landed
programme.desc: Georgia og Callums forhold settes på prøve når den eksen de frykter mest dukker opp. Spenningen gnistrer over La Demis siste kjærlighet. En romantisk Hot Date blir belønnet.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: SOS, Save Our Singles
programme.desc: En sjokkerende "Sauna of Secrets" betyr at singlene må passe seg under "Ice Ceremony". Allie og Nialls av og på-forhold gjør at Allie havner på gyngende grunn.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Ex-Cuzzi
programme.desc: En perfekt date blir til et perfekt mareritt for et par. Niall får seriøs konkurranse om Allies hengivenhet. Marlon og La Demi kjemper for å finne ut av situasjon-forholdet.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Mums the Word
programme.desc: Georgia og Callum møter sine verste kritikere. Marlon fanges mellom en stein og en varmt sted da en eks som eventyrer forholdet hansmed La Demi ankommer. Ice Ceremony tar en uventet vri.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Don't Say Soulmate
programme.desc: Når en første kjørlighet ankommer the Peak, kastes de gyldne parene inn i en loop. En ny forbindelse og et overraskende valg under "Hot Date" får Tyranny til å se rødt.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Adore-able Mess
programme.desc: Adores besøk på "Sauna of Secrets" setter romansen med Tyler på spill. En ny eks innebærer en velkommen distraksjon. La Demis innstilling til eksen sin, får bestevennen hennes til å vende seg mot henne under Ice Ceremony.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Breaking Winter Balls
programme.desc: Adore presses til å velge mellom eksen og sin neste, og presser en av dem i et sjalusiutbrudd. En heit date blir belønnet, noe som får spenningen til å gnistre og gir noen hjertesorg.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Liar, Liar, Chalet on Fire
programme.desc: En sjokkerende løgndetektortest gjør hele huset rasende, og et sterkt par mister troen på forholdet sitt. Endelig får Georgia vite sannheten om Callum og Paris.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Say Yes to the Next
programme.desc: Sannhetsseremonien har etterlatt sommerhuset i kaos, og parene skal endelig bestemme om de vil dra med eksen, den neste eller alene. En singel stiller spørsmålet mens andre drar opprørte når sannheten er for mye å ta inn.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Love, Next Love
programme.desc: Ti realitystjerner ankommer paradiset for å finne sin neste kjærlighet. Samtidig vet de at eksene deres kommer til å ødelegge festen. Kommer eksene i veien for deres nyutkårne eller blir de deres neste?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Serving Revenge
programme.desc: Shack of Secrets overrasker og gir Mark og Elena innsikt om deres forholds tidslinje. En ny eks får ikke bestemt seg om de er her for kjærlighet eller hevn. En eks blir sendt hjem.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: I Put a Crush on You
programme.desc: Et telefonspill fører til et oppgjør mellom Aubrey og Devin. En morsom malefest utvikler seg til det verre. Første 'Crush Date' får en pris.
programme.sub-title: I Put a Crush on You

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Cam You Feel the Love Tonight
programme.desc: Cameron blir fanget mellom eksen og den neste. Et par sliter med å bli enige om de er et par, eller ikke. En eks blir sendt hjem.
programme.sub-title: Cam You Feel the Love Tonight

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: This is Episode 5 But Let's Call It 6
programme.desc: Devin møter Maries sinne da han kaller henne 'a six'. Billy prøver seg på Lexi. En ny eks blir en spennende nestemann for en singel. En Crush Date blir belønnet.
programme.sub-title: This is Episode 5 But Let's Call It 6

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: The Mother of All Secrets
programme.desc: En ny eks og et besøk av mamma forrykker et spirende forhold. Marie kjemper med å være 'a six.' Singlene samler seg for å sende hjem et eks som hindrer en venn fra å finne sin neste.
