programme.title: South Park: Sexhjelpen
programme.desc: Kyle og Butters befinner seg midt blant Amerikas superkjendiser når de gjennomgår en behandling for sexavhengighet. Cartman og Stan er limt til Tiger Woods-kampen.

programme.title: South Park: Mitt fremtidige meg
programme.desc: South Park blir rammet av en kraftig storm, og en naken fremmed påstår at han er Stan fra fremtiden.

programme.title: South Park: Pandemispesial
programme.desc: Det går opp for Randy hvilken betydning han har for koronautbruddet etter hvert som pandemien gir innbyggerne i South Park stadig nye utfordringer.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: South Park får høre om flotte japanske toaletter.

programme.title: South Park: Dopapir
programme.desc: Guttene vandaliserer kunstlærerens hus med toalettpapir, men Kyle blir så plaget av skyldfølelse at han vil dø.

programme.title: South Park: Ikes tissefant
programme.desc: Kyle prøver å forhindre at lillebrorens penis blir skåret av.

programme.title: South Park: Følg etter det egget!
programme.desc: For å hindre Mr. Slave i å gifte seg med Big Gay Al ber Ms. Garrison barna om hjelp i et eksperiment for å bevise at homofile ekteskap ikke fungerer.

programme.title: South Park: Helvete på jord 2006
programme.desc: Det er halloween, og Satan holder verdens største kostymefest.

programme.title: South Park: Faith Hilling
programme.desc: Den siste memetrenden som treffer byen er 'Faith Hilling', men trenden blir umoderne etter en at Faith Hilling-hendelse forstyrrer Republikanernes president-debatt.

programme.title: South Park: Cartman finner kjærligheten
programme.desc: Cartman spiller matchmaker når en ny jente flytter til South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Succubusen
programme.desc: Cartman går til optiker, som gjør narr av Cartmans vektproblemer og kaller ham 'Piggy'.

programme.title: South Park: Cartmanland
programme.desc: Cartman arver en million dollar fra bestemoren og virkeliggjør drømmen om å ha sin egen fornøyelsespark: Cartmanland!

programme.title: South Park: Datakalenderen
programme.desc: Cartman skryter av sin nye Trapper Keeper, men en fremmed forteller ham at den snart vil ta over verden om de ikke ødelegger den nå.

programme.title: South Park: Fantasilandet I
programme.desc: Guttene kommer til et magisk land der hele verdens fantasi ligger foran dem, men terroristplaner truer med å ødelegge alt sammen.

programme.title: South Park: Den standhaftige dagen
programme.desc: Jimmy er redd for at konstant ereksjon skal hindre ham i å delta i talentkonkurransen og vinne 1000 dollar.

programme.title: South Park: Fytti lesba!
programme.desc: Ms. Garrison blir dumpet igjen og bestemmer seg for at hun er lesbisk. Guttene hyrer meksikanske innvandrere for å gjøre leksene for dem.

programme.title: South Park: Trygt sted
programme.desc: Cartman er siste offer innen kroppsskam.

programme.title: South Park: Frem med pikkene
programme.desc: Guttene går sammen for å kjempe for sine rettigheter.

programme.title: South Park: Den skumle fisken
programme.desc: Sharon Marshs tante Flo har gaver til Shelly og Stan. Shelly får et flott stereoanlegg, mens Stan får en skummel fisk.

programme.title: South Park: Glade hologram
programme.desc: Cartman trender, mens resten av USA forbereder seg til det største juleprogrammet på tv noensinne.

programme.title: South Park: Kenny dør
programme.desc: Kenny utvikler en dødelig sykdom, og Stan har problemer med å takle det.

programme.title: South Park: Sagaen om Skrevert Kukirævinen
programme.desc: Butters får skylda - og deretter æren - etter at gutta skriver en bok som skulle være uhørt uhøflig, men som blir hyllet som et mesterverk.

programme.title: South Park: Et mareritt på Face Time
programme.desc: Randys store planer for Halloween gjør at Stan ikke får gå 'Knask eller knep' med vennene sine.

programme.title: South Park: Hummel-figurer og heroin
programme.desc: Feirede underholdere faller fra i sine beste år på grunn av massive overdoser av opiater. Stan er i ferd med å bli avslørt som kilden til de illegale stoffene.

programme.title: South Park: Du har null venner
programme.desc: Mot bedre vitende, blir Stan med på Facebook og blir en sosialt nettworkende 'juggernaut', noe som forårsaker at han selv blir sugd inn i websiden.

programme.title: South Park: Det er jul i Kanada
programme.desc: Kyles adoptivbror Ike blir hentet av sine biologiske foreldre fordi den kanadiske statsministeren har bestemt at alle bortadopterte kanadiske barn må returnere til landet.

programme.title: South Park: Lattermaskinen
programme.desc: Etter å ha blitt gjort narr av på The South Park Elementary Comedy Awards, bygger Germany en uovervinnerlig lattermaskin: Funnybot. Men dens planer for menneskeheten går likevel ikke altfor bra.

programme.title: South Park: South Park
programme.desc: Stan oppdager til sin forferdelse at han har misforstått en av tidenes viktiste forfattere.

programme.title: South Park: Fantasilandet III
programme.desc: Stan og Butters er fanget i Imaginationland og må kjempe for livet mot en hær av onde krefter. Kyle og Cartman er fortsatt i Pentagon.

programme.title: South Park: Fjerde klasse
programme.desc: Barna skal begynne i fjerde klasse, men liker det dårlig.

programme.title: South Park: Chef Aid
programme.desc: Chef prøver å kreve royalties da et plateselskap slipper en låt han hevder han skrev for over 20 år siden.

programme.title: South Park: Professor Kaos
programme.desc: Gutta gir Butters sparken som venn og vekker hans mørke side.

programme.title: South Park: Feitrumpe og pannekakehode
programme.desc: Cartman lager en J-Lo-fingerdukke til et arrangement som skal hylle latinamerikanere.

programme.title: South Park: Informativ mordporno
programme.desc: Gutta bruker spillet Minecraft for å prøve å forhindre at foreldrene deres skader hverandre.

programme.title: South Park: Sannsynligvis (del 2)
programme.desc: Satan ber Gud om hjelp i en krise, og Cartman blir avslørt som en bedrager. Han sendes til Mexico som straff.

programme.title: South Park: Usikkerhet
programme.desc: Cartman registrerer seg for et hjemme-sikkerhetssystem.

programme.title: Games People Play: The Way You Save
programme.desc: Kareem sier til Marcus at han ikke kan leve i skyggen av ham, og ber ham kjøpe ham ut så han kan gå videre. Marcus gir ham 250 000 med sin velsignelse. Kareem og Quanisha går til Jamal med en sekk penger for å betale så han skal dra.

programme.title: Boomerang: Don't Wanna Love You
programme.desc: Påvirkningens krefter utforsker når influereren Tia får en velbetalt en-kvelds gig på en strippeklubb. Samtidig blir David påvirket av en ny megakirke.

programme.title: Boomerang: Reversal Of a Dog
programme.desc: Bryson får den ikke opp og passerer de akseptable grensene for mannlig intimitet når han prøver å snakke om det hos barbereren; Ari vurderer grensene for hans seksualitet og maskulinitet, og utfordrer hans selvfølelse.

programme.title: Boomerang: Day Weekend
programme.desc: Simone samler gjengen og særskilte andre på farens luksusstrandhus. Det skulle føre alle sammen, men slutter med å vise hvordan alle har forandret seg og muligens vokst fra hverandre.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Freedom
programme.desc: Mary Jane lover på å nyte en angstfri helg, men planen skjærer seg når Mark ber henne om hjelp med foreldrene som er på besøk. Åpenbaringer tvinger Mark til å forandre.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Mary Jane Knows Best
programme.desc: Da Mary Janes affære ble avslørt, tvinges hun til å innse at hun er mer hekta enn hun trodde. Patricks nykterhetsfest gir et bilde av den mannen han engang var.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Sleepless In Atlanta
programme.desc: Kara vil beskytte Mary Jane fra resultatet av en fokusgruppe, Niecy prøver å verne seg seg og Treyvion for faren hans, som uventet dukker opp fra college. Patrick prøver å balansere arbeid og familie, og Mary Jane treffer Sheldon.

programme.title: Twenties: The Pilot
programme.desc: Den ambisiøse manusforfatteren Hattie finner seg kastet ut, arbeidsløs og ulykkelig. Så løper hun på den berømte forfatteren og produsenten Ida B, hvis serie Cocoa's Butter Hattie has fulgt i sosiale medier.

programme.title: Twenties: I've Got The World On A String
programme.desc: Hattie navigerer kontorpolitikk på sin første dag som forfatterassisten. Samtidig krangler Marie med sin spillende mor mens Nia sjanser på en date med yogaeleven sin.
programme.sub-title: I've Got The World On A String

programme.title: Twenties: Happy Place
programme.desc: Hattie leter forgjeves etter et velvalgt sted å skrive. Marie presses mot den eneste svarte studiosjefen. Nia spør seg om hun har valgt riktig karriere.

programme.title: Twenties: You Know How I Like It
programme.desc: Tiden er imot Hattie når hun slår seg gjennom Hollywood på ulike jobber fra Ida B. Nia kjemper med en prøvespilling.
programme.sub-title: You Know How I Like It

programme.title: Boomerang: Hot Sex
programme.desc: Crystal reiser alene til Paris for å feire sin nye jobb. Først mer interessert i sosiale medier, oppdager hun eventyr og romantikk uten mobilen. Hun blir en ny sterk, sexy, uavhengig Crystal, som ikke defineres av vennene sine.

programme.title: Boomerang: Feels Like Heaven
programme.desc: Davis har en sjudagers religiøs faste og går inn i en drømmeaktig tilstand. Han følger heltens reise for å finne Gud for å få de svarene han søker.

programme.title: Boomerang: End of the Road
programme.desc: Sesongen slutter i at gjengen omgås. Men ved nærmere øyensyn, er de kanskje ikke de samme som de en gang var. Kanskje de virkelig har vokst fra hverandre.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: No Eggspectations
programme.desc: Kara foreslår en levende versjon av 'Talk Back', men verken hun eller Mary Jane er forberedt på nyheten dr. Marrs kommer med. Cameron og Niecy forhandler om hans gjenkomst i hennes liv.

programme.title: Twenties: Ain't Nothing Like The Real Thing
programme.desc: Et jordskjelv påvirker vennskapet. Marie blir på vakt for Chuck når en pornokveld tar av. Hattie blir mer begeistret for Ida når hun sorterer gamle manuskript, noe som fører til en åpenhjertig samtale som er både intim og elskverdig.
programme.sub-title: Ain't Nothing Like The Real Thing

programme.title: Twenties: Redemption Song
programme.desc: Hattie får lære å balansere arbeid og familie. Arbeidet fører Nia til kirken for å rydde opp i Zacs rot, og overtaler stjernebasketspilleren Quintrelle til å tegne kontrakt med studioet.

programme.title: Twenties: What Would Todd Do?
programme.desc: I improvisasjonstimen kjemper Nia med å få stereotype svarte roller. Marie blir rasende over Ben blir forfremmet foran henne, og leter etter svar. Hattie prøver å gjøre sin stemme hørt i forfatterrommet.

programme.title: Twenties: Living The Dream
programme.desc: I et modig forsøk på å gi Nia en rolle i Cocoa's Butter, blir Hattie sparket fra serien. Marie avholder en spesiell fødselsdagsmiddag som får en vri når en uventet gjest dukker opp.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: One Is The Loneliest Number
programme.desc: Mary Jane og kollegene rystes av en dødelig skoleskyting i Atlanta.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Line In The Sand
programme.desc: Mary Jane blir nominert for Emmy-prisen, og må søke råd hos gode venner. Tidsnok må hun bestemme seg for å ta sjansen og følge instinktet. Samtidig blir informasjon om Tracy kjent.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Primetime
programme.desc: Cynthia er syk og Mary Jane og Kara leder og produserer et nyhetsprogram i beste sendetid. Av andre begivenheter velger Paul jr. arbeidstilbud.

programme.title: The New Edition Story: Night One
programme.desc: Livene til fem barndomsvenner fra Roxbury-prosjektet i Massachusetts endrer seg for alltid når de danner en sanggruppe for å vinne en lokal talentkonkurranse. Til slutt blir de det legendariske R&B-bandet New Edition.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Reading The Signs
programme.desc: Mary Janes fraser blir virale og gjør henne til en sensasjon over natten. Sheldon kjemper med å ta forholdet deres til neste nivå. Kara drar for å hjelpe til med et komplisert familieproblem.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Signing Off
programme.desc: Mary Jane Paul virker å ha alt; intelligens, driv, et pent hjem, sportsbil og en overdådig garderobe med designersko. Tross det mangler noe i hennes amerikanske drøm - en egen familie.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Facing Fears
programme.desc: Mary Jane hastes på sykehus etter ulykken og familien flokkes rundt henne. Paul sr. håndterer David og Helen befrir dem for Lisa. Kara kjemper for Mary Jane på SNC.

programme.title: The New Edition Story: Night Two
programme.desc: Though New Edition become R&B sensations, their fame comes at a steep price as internal tension and external pressure leads them to put business before friendship.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Deadline
programme.desc: Allan kommer til Sydney, han har 12 timer før et Necron-virus dreper ham med mindre han leverer Tau til en utpresser som har motgift.

programme.title: Andromeda: Hvis hjulet er løst
programme.desc: Beka og Tyr blir overtatt av energien fra en dimensjonal tunnel. Dylan, Trance og Harper må redde dem før de ødelegger skipet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Skårene i Rimni
programme.desc: Dylan er innrammet for drap og må rydde navnet sitt mens han finner bitene i en vase som sies å gi eieren kosmos 'velsignelser.'

programme.title: Andromeda: Mad to Be Saved
programme.desc: Mannskapet redder en gruppe flyktninger, bare for å oppdage at de har vært utsatt for regjeringseksperimenter og er ekstremt ustabile.

programme.title: Andromeda: Cui Bono
programme.desc: Bekas onkel løper for kontoret i New Commonwealth, men et attentat får mannskapet til å opptre som hans sikkerhet.

programme.title: Mutant X: Into the Moonless Night
programme.desc: I den spennende sesongåpningen kommer de overlevende medlemmene av Mutant X ut av en dødelig eksplosjon for å møte Lexa, som får dem til å begynne å stille spørsmål ved grunnleggende antagelser om deres verden.

programme.title: Mutant X: Wages of Sin
programme.desc: Mutant X-teamet må stoppe auksjonen av et sterkt dødelig stoff som flere beryktede internasjonale terrorister kjemper om å skaffe seg.

programme.title: Mutant X: The Breed
programme.desc: Mutant X-teamet blir hentet inn for å hjelpe en militærbase som har blitt smittet med en dødelig sykdom.

programme.title: Mutant X: Where Evil Dwell
programme.desc: Mutant X-teamet må stoppe en seriemorder som etterlater ledetråder til sine neste ofre i form av gåter.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Wages of Sydney
programme.desc: Quan Shu, Manchuria 1359 f.Kr.: Kineserne oppfinner et eksplosivt gaveegg. New York, 2001: En rival slår Sydney og Nigel til et kart som fører til Dragon's Egg.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Vampire's Kiss
programme.desc: Lucas Blackmer, en babymagnet, professor og romanforfatter, ber Sydney hjelpe til med å finne Vlad Tepes 'tapte relikvie. Og han er ikke den eneste etter det.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Mr. Right
programme.desc: Sydney støter på eksen Gray og drar på ferie med ham til Bali, men når Derek Lloyd dukker opp for å verve henne til å finne Parvati's Bowl, kan hun ikke motstå.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Sydney at Ten
programme.desc: Sydneys samboer fra skolen er på sporet med et anheng fra fortiden hennes og verver Sydney for å hjelpe til med å finne den og fange morderen.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den ensomme og jevne sanden
programme.desc: Når Andromeda blir angrepet av rompirater, blir de reddet av et langt mistet romskip fra jorden.

programme.title: Andromeda: Slipfighter Hunder av Krig
programme.desc: Mannskapet oppdager at en falsk planet, Marduk, har skapt masseødeleggelsesvåpen.

programme.title: Andromeda: Lepras kyss
programme.desc: En hitman med navnet Leper er rettet mot lederne for det nye samveldet.

programme.title: Andromeda: For hvem bjelleveiene
programme.desc: Andromeda hjemsøkes av en mystisk skapning som kommer ombord under en solstorm.

programme.title: Mutant X: The Taking of Crows
programme.desc: Når Lexa uvitende er dopet med et dødelig stoff, må teamet løpe for å finne motgiften før det er for sent.

programme.title: Mutant X: Shadows of Darkness
programme.desc: Mutant X-teamet blir kalt inn for å undersøke bisarre aktiviteter som skjer på et lokalt sykehus.

programme.title: Mutant X: The Hand of God
programme.desc: Mutant X-teamet legger ut på oppdrag for å finne og fange en kraftig supermutant som har gudlignende krefter.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: The teams roll the dice to determine the ingredients for their next team challenge, while a contestant leaves due to an injury. The cooks cater for music legends during dinner service, including Stewart Copeland and Steven Tyler.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: Following the departure of two contestants from the competition, those remaining are challenged to create Indian-inspired meals, with the winning team earning a day of pampering at a luxurious spa.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay puts aspiring chefs through tough challenges. The teams are challenged to a blind taste test. Dinner service is held in honour of a group of decorated firefighters.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: The teams are challenged to create their own amuse-bouches, with the winners enjoying a helicopter ride to a luxury location and the losers preparing coconuts for dinner service.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: The teams are tasked with creating mouthwatering steak dishes in a bid to impress Gordon and the owner of a renowned steak restaurant.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: The remaining chefs cater for 40 `glampers' before a hectic dinner service which leads to a difficult decision for the chefs and Gordon himself. Someone will have to pay the ultimate price and be forced to leave the competition at this late stage.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: The four remaining chefs are reunited with their loved ones for a taste test, with the winner dining out with their family at a posh restaurant.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: Gordon's top two feel the pressure as they prepare their final menus. The pair do not have long to ponder and consider whether a simple or more adventurous approach will win the day.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: This season's contestants head to Las Vegas where they participate in the signature dish challenge; the winners of the challenge ride on the world's tallest Big wheel while the losers peel 50 pounds of shrimp and 1,000 pounds of potatoes.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: The teams have 20 minutes to see which team can produce the most shrimp dumplings; rapper The Game attends the dinner service.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: The chefs are given a communication challenge. VIP guests for dinner service include astronaut Buzz Aldrin.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: Kris Jenner and Dita Von Teese enjoy duck dishes as one team pulls off a near-perfect dinner service.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: The winners of this week's challenge enjoy a wine blending experience, before a disastrous dinner service leads to a shock departure.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: Dinner sees the 12 remaining chefs serving octopus, steak and lobster, but lacklustre performances from both teams leave Gordon Ramsay far from impressed.

programme.title: Melrose Place: En dominikansk skilsmisse
programme.desc: Amanda blir med Rory til Den dominikanske republikk for å gifte seg med ham. Hun kjenner ikke til hans plan om å drepe henne og ta pengene hennes.

programme.desc: Peter forteller Lexi at han fortsatt har følelser for Amanda. Lexi får vite at hun kan få skylden for sin avdøde fars tyverianklager.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Et usunt par
programme.desc: Taylor hakker på Michaels forakt for foreldrerollen mens hun fortsatt bor hos ham. Michael begynner å date den nye resepsjonisten.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Vedhenget Jane
programme.desc: Michael drar på collegegjenforening i Chicago for å slippe unna Taylors innblanding.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Det blir ikke verre
programme.desc: Michael prøver å skjule Taylor fra Jane etter at hun blir med ham tilbake til Los Angeles. Men de to finner til slutt ut om hverandre.

programme.title: Melrose Place: God kveld, Mr. Campbell, del 1
programme.desc: Da Amanda blir bortført og det kreves $1 000 000 i løsepenger, tilbyr Peter seg å hjelpe Kyle med å få henne trygt tilbake.

programme.title: Melrose Place: God kveld, Mr. Campbell, del 2
programme.desc: Etter å ha levert løsepengene tar Peter rollen som Amandas helt. Men hun flykter fra hytta og blir forfulgt av en av kidnapperne.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Verden ifølge Matt
programme.desc: Megan begjærer plutselig Michael igjen etter at Cooper drar til Philadelphia. Men Michael har andre planer, og frir til Jane.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Der horene gror
programme.desc: Michael følger Megan til hennes tidligere hjem på en hesteranch og treffer hennes mor og invalide far.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Doktor sjalusi
programme.desc: Etter en slåsskamp med Alex bestemmer Michael seg for å teste Janes trofasthet. Megan begynner å jobbe for Lexis byrå.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Ikke alt om Eve
programme.desc: Lexi blir med Megan på middag med Ryan og skremmer Amanda med sin forretningssans. Samtidig prøver Ryan å finne ut av Lexis planer.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Ryktehviskeren
programme.desc: Etter en krangel tilstår Michael troskapstesten for Jane, som gir ham et ultimatum: Han må slutte å spionere på henne, ellers blir det ikke noe bryllup.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Kvelden lyset gikk i Melrose
programme.desc: Jane flytter midlertidig inn i Melrose-komplekset igjen, og Michael følger med på henne mens hun går med på å bli modell for Alex.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Mistanke
programme.desc: Amanda sender Jane til Chicago for å hjelpe Alex med å forbli kunde hos Amanda Woodward Advertising. Jane sverger på at det bare er forretninger.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Spilling på taket
programme.desc: På Michael og Janes bryllupsdag prøver den utspekulerte Lexi å holde Ryan unna seremonien, og Jane får dårlig samvittighet.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Dødellig bryllup 4
programme.desc: Peter og Eve drar til Peters hjemby etter at faren hans dør. Peter revurderer livet sitt.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Når heiagjenger angriper
programme.desc: Kyle får vite om forholdet mellom Eve og Amanda da de forteller om kvelden de slo seg sammen mot Eves voldelige kjæreste.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Plutselig sæd
programme.desc: Michaels eiendomsmegler forfører ham da han vil selge strandhuset. Samtidig tenker Jane på sitt første møte med Michael.

programme.title: Melrose Place: De vanlige julenissene
programme.desc: Juleferien begynner dårlig for alle da Peter, Michael, Kyle, Ryan og Louis Vicontti forveksles med en gruppe bankranere.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Beleiring
programme.desc: Rangernes ferie på et avsidesliggende sted blir til en katt-og-mus-lek med en notorisk heroinlanger som fanger Walker, Trivette, C.D. og Alex i en forlatt hytte etter at Alex ser ham lange.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Moskva-forbindelsen
programme.desc: En rekke lagerran leder Walker og Trivette til en russisk mafiasjef, og rangerne innkaller Moskva-politiet for å identifisere og fakke skurken.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Mirakel i Middle Creek
programme.desc: En seksåring faller ned i et 12 meter dypt avløp, og Walker prøver å redde ham. Men når hullet raser sammen, blir Walker og gutten sittende fast uten mye til håp.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Æresgalleriet
programme.desc: Kvelden før C.D. skal innlemmes i Texas Rangers’ Æresgalleri hjemsøker en seriemorder fra en 11 år gammel sak ham, og han begynner å tvile på om han fortjener æren.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Høyere makter
programme.desc: Walker prøver å holde en familie samlet etter at en tibetansk munk oppdager at ånden til Lama Dolgin har blitt reinkarnert som en ung gutt og prøver å ta gutten med til Tibet.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Patriot
programme.desc: Når Walker og Trivette arresterer lederen for en høyreekstrem gruppe, hevner gruppen seg ved å ta Alex og de ansatte ved en minoritetseid TV-stasjon som gissel.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Spøkelsesrytteren
programme.desc: Når byggarbeidere avdekker en ung indianergutts forråtnede lik, prøver Walker og Trivette å løse en gammel forbrytelse. Men når ingen i byen vil snakke, har de bare skjelettet å gå ut fra.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Brorskap
programme.desc: Et hevnlystent politibrorskap begynner å drepe skurker som slippes fri, og Walker må gjøre slutt på terroren.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Pest
programme.desc: Walker må redde livet til sine venner på Cherokee-reservatet når de settes i fare av et selskap som driver et eksperimentelt meieri og velger fremtidig profitt fremfor sikkerhet.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Forløsning
programme.desc: Det er Cahill mot Cahill når sjefen for en forbryterliga hyrer Alex sin alkoholiserte far, Gordon Cahill, som forsvarsadvokat.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Kodenavn: Dragonfly
programme.desc: Walkers nemesis fra Vietnam-tiden stjeler et hemmelig militærhelikopter for å smugle dop for kartellene, og Walker får sjansen til å rydde opp i gatene og gjøre opp for fortiden.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Et stille rop
programme.desc: Darcy Reynolds, datteren til Walkers venn, voldtas etter at drinken hennes blir dopet på 21-årsdagen hennes. Walker leter etter overfallsmennene på nattklubbene i Dallas.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Svanesang
programme.desc: Når et styrtet fly som ble brukt i et bankran og drapet på Walkers venn åtte år tidligere oppdages i Utahs fjell, drar Walker dit for å prøve å løse saken.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Syklon
programme.desc: Alex og C.D. følger en gruppe barn hjem etter "Barn i regjeringen" når de tas som gisler av kidnappere som begraver bussen deres i gjørme, og Walker må redde dem før en syklon når dem.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Lucky
programme.desc: To eiendomsutviklere dreper en prest for å hindre byggingen av et jobbsenter for hjemløse. Det fins bare to øyenvitner: en hjemløs mann som har forsvunnet og hunden Lucky som hjelper Walker.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Den dødeligste mannen i live
programme.desc: Verdens dødeligste leiemorder, som kan ha vært involvert i drapet på JFK, har blitt funnet i Dallas, og Walker må gjøre slutt på terroren før Israels ambassadør blir hans neste offer.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: En rangers jul
programme.desc: En julefest for foreldreløse barn på C.D.’s blir scenen for Walkers fortelling, en rangers versjon av Charles Dickens’ "En julefortelling".

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Mayday
programme.desc: Walker og Charlie Brooks, et nøkkelvitne han eskorterer, overlever mirakuløst når flyet deres sprenges over Utah. Walker må lede de overlevende, inkludert en kvinne i barsel, til sikkerhet.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Siste håp
programme.desc: Walker, Alex, C.D. og Trivette tar en gruppe barn med på Ranger-leir for en helg, uten å vite at en av guttene har stjålet penger fra doplangere og satt dem alle i fare.

programme.title: 97 Minutes
programme.desc: Et kapret fly vil styrte om bare 97 minutter når det går tom for drivstoff. NSA-direktøren vil at flyet skal skytes ned før den tid, og overlater skjebnen til de uskyldige passasjerene til en hemmelig Interpol-agent.

programme.title: Fortress
programme.desc: Den tidligere CIA-agenten Robert bor på et hemmelig feriested for tidligere spioner. Nå er hans sønn Paul havnet i trøbbel og trenger hans hjelp. Dessverre er ikke Pauls planer så hemmelige som livet til faren.

programme.title: The Ice Road
programme.desc: Etter at en fjerntliggende diamantgruve kollapser i Nord-Canada tar Mike oppdraget med å lede redningsoperasjonen, og må trosse de brutale naturkreftene i Canadas villmark.

programme.title: Taken 3
programme.desc: Eks-agenten Bryan Mills er forsont med sin tidligere kone, men lykken blir kortvarig når hun brutalt myrdes og han blir beskyldt for udåden.

programme.title: Fortress: Sniper's Eye
programme.desc: Den pensjonerte CIA-agenten Robert legger ut på en dristig redningsaksjon av erkefiendens enke, Sasha. Men snart blir Robert konfrontert med et kjent ansikt han trodde han aldri ville se igjen...

programme.title: Till Death
programme.desc: Etter en romantisk kveld i deres avsidesliggende hus, våkner Emma opp lenket til sin døde ektemann. Hun er fanget og isolert og må kjempe mot leiemordere for å unnslippe ektemannens avsindige plan.

programme.title: Official Secrets
programme.desc: Den sanne historien om en britisk varsler som lekket informasjon til media om en ulovlig NSA-operasjon, hvis formål var å presse FNs sikkerhetsråd til å godkjenne invasjonen av Irak i 2003.

programme.title: Red Dawn
programme.desc: Når en amerikansk by blir invadert av nordkoreanske soldater, kommer en gruppe unge mennesker sammen for å beskytte hverandre, frigjøre byen og gjenvinne sin frihet.

programme.title: Taken
programme.desc: Den tidligere agenten Bryan Mills begynner de lengste 96 timene i sitt liv når han tar opp jakten på mennene som kidnappet datteren hans.

programme.title: The Disappearance of Eleanor Rigby: Them
programme.desc: Engang var Conor og Eleanor lykkelig gift. Nå føler de seg fremmed for hverandre, og i kjølevannet av en tragisk hendelse lengter de etter å finne tilbake til det liv og den kjærligheten de engang hadde.

programme.title: Wildfire: Push Me/Pull You
programme.desc: Kris worries about her status at Raintree after Gillian moves into the bunkhouse with Matt and begins offering unsolicited advice about Wildfire's training.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Good-Bye
programme.desc: With Raintree in dire financial straits, Jean and Matt's willingness to consider a buyer's offer draws criticism from Pablo and Kris.

programme.title: Wildfire: Heartless
programme.desc: Kris increasingly becomes the object of Matt's affection; this renders his relationship with Gillian incompatible.

programme.title: Wildfire: Diplomacy
programme.desc: Kris and Matt's rekindled relationship comes as a shock to Junior, who is distracted by consoling Dani in her time of mourning.

programme.title: Wildfire: You Can't Count On Me
programme.desc: Kris' endeavors to get accustomed to her new relationship with Matt and deal with Pablo's departure are interrupted by a surprise visit from her half brother (Ignacio Serricchio).

programme.title: Wildfire: Picking Sides
programme.desc: Kris tries to repair the rift between Matt and Junior, but the tension is exacerbated by the approach of the important Bristol Stakes and the return of Gillian, who proceeds to resume her bonding with Junior.

programme.title: Wildfire: So Long, Pardner
programme.desc: In the third-season finale, Kris and Matt weigh a generous offer from Sheik Omar that would go a long way toward easing Raintree's financial woes---but that also may be against the law.

programme.title: Wildfire: The More Things Change: Part 1
programme.desc: The fourth season begins six months after Kris was forced out of Raintree, which has undergone significant operational changes that leave Matt pining for the past.

programme.title: Wildfire: The More Things Change: Part 2
programme.desc: After Kris unexpectedly returns for a glimpse of Wildfire's next race, she gains an unlikely ally and a place to stay.

programme.title: Wildfire: Calm
programme.desc: Jean and Pablo are adamant that Kris leave town instead of sticking around and helping to care for Wildfire.

programme.title: Wildfire: Flames
programme.desc: Kris and Junior help Matt with his improbable plan to get Raintree back in the horse-racing business, which involves finding Wildfire's offspring, Flame.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Friend
programme.desc: Junior's preoccupation with his and Calvin's business proposition takes time away from his wedding plans, but Laura suspects his loss of focus may have something to do with Kris.

programme.title: Wildfire: Friendship/Passion
programme.desc: The pressure is on Junior to decide whether or not to go through with his wedding to Laura after he and Kris share a moment of passion.

programme.title: Wildfire: Commitment Issues
programme.desc: When it appears that Flame is ready for his first race, Kris decides to fight to get her jockey's license reinstated.

programme.title: Wildfire: Life's Too Short
programme.desc: Kris hopes that Flame's success in the DuPont Stakes might help Jean change her mind about Raintree's future, but Kris isn't so sure about what part---if any---she'll play in it.

programme.title: Wildfire: Vows
programme.desc: Kris and Junior hastily decide to get married, but they're forced to postpone their plans when Jean is injured by one of the horses rescued by Matt.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Comeback
programme.desc: With Jean still out of commission, Kris and Matt do their best to run the dude ranch at Raintree while also preparing for the next race, which features Dani's new horse in the field

programme.title: Wildfire: Being Mrs. Junior
programme.desc: Universal disapproval of Kris and Junior's wedding plans has everyone on edge, and even Kris wonders if she has what it takes to be part of the Davis family.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Ties That Bind: Part 1
programme.desc: Kris and Junior consider a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to relocate to Alaska for a year to work on a geothermal project in the series' penultimate episode.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Ties That Bind: Part 2
programme.desc: In the series finale, Junior's schedule goes haywire when an urgent matter in Alaska that requires his attention coincides with Kris'ride on Wildfire in the Tucker Stakes and their wedding.

programme.title: On the Case: Fatal Footage
programme.desc: An innocent mother of two is mysteriously shot in downtown Philadelphia. Surveillance cameras record every detail but can't unmask the killer.

programme.title: On the Case: Blood, Sweat and Tears
programme.desc: A cold case team reopens the investigation into the murder of 36-year-old Linda Robinson who is savagely murdered while her seven-year-old niece is asleep in the next room.

programme.title: On the Case: A Murder in Pelham
programme.desc: A daughter spends 25 years pursuing the truth behind her mother's mysterious murder.

programme.title: On the Case: Trail of Tears
programme.desc: A young woman's mysterious murder sends detectives on a heartbreaking search for the truth.

programme.title: On the Case: At Death's Door
programme.desc: After a single mother is viciously attacked and left for dead, she still manages to help police track down her assailant.

programme.title: On the Case: A Murder at Loose Chippings
programme.desc: After a wealthy couple is found dead in their stately Virginia home, investigators are taken on a wild journey around the globe before they uncover the shocking truth.

programme.title: On the Case: Innocent Witness
programme.desc: When Rhonda Boggs is discovered murdered in her own kitchen, police get an important lead from the only witness to the crime, Rhonda's two year old daughter.

programme.title: On the Case: Footprints and Whispers
programme.desc: A beloved husband and wife are found dead in their own home. Will the killers own words bring him to justice?

programme.title: On the Case: Pattern of Violence
programme.desc: A 22 year old real estate agent is discovered strangled to death inside a model home she was trying to sell.

programme.title: On the Case: Field of Nightmares
programme.desc: A young mother and son are found shot to death in a quiet Texas field. Would a mysterious bag left at the crime scene hold the key to catching their killer?

programme.title: On the Case: Snake in the Grass
programme.desc: A cloud of smoke leads two truckers to a shocking discovery; the smoldering remains of a teenage girl.

programme.title: On the Case: Fatal Turn
programme.desc: A devoted mother vanishes on her way home from work. Her disappearance sends police into the darkest corners of the state and our justice system.

programme.title: On the Case: A Stranger's Knock
programme.desc: When firefighters respond to a house fire they discover a woman shot and killed inside. Police must unlock the mystery of who started the blaze to solve the murder.

programme.title: On the Case: Last Rites
programme.desc: When a nun is found strangled and stabbed to death on the day before Easter, investigators are forced to look behind church walls in search of a killer.

programme.title: On the Case: Murder by the Numbers?
programme.desc: A small town is outraged when its unofficial mayor is the victim of a vicious attack at work. The police investigation uncovers a number of possible suspects and a confusing trail of evidence but will it lead them to the person who committed the crime?

programme.title: On the Case: A Thin Disguise
programme.desc: A mysterious stranger ambushes a family as they pull into their driveway. Could the memories of a five year old girl be the key to solving the crime?

programme.title: On the Case: Bound by the Truth
programme.desc: When a retired professor is found murdered, police must figure out whether the victim's son and daughter in law were eyewitnesses or the killers.

programme.title: On the Case: Murder in Room 205
programme.desc: A young woman's journey to a new life comes to a savage end in a roadside motel.

programme.title: On the Case: Sirens in the Night
programme.desc: Paula takes a look at the shocking discovery of a mysterious young woman who is found in the ashes of a fire.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Sunk
programme.desc: Joe and Mikey hire a helicopter for a salvage mission to retrieve the rare tailpiece from a Lockheed 10-A that crashed in the Yellowknife woods forty years ago.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Turkey or Bust
programme.desc: Justin and Cory are stranded in Croatia while trying to complete the delivery of two CL-215 water bombers to Turkey.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Cold Start
programme.desc: Mikey links up with Chris Hadfield aboard the International Space Station. Problems mount while trying to get a frozen DC-4 airborne. A landing gear collapse on the runway sends the entire crew scrambling.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Shootout
programme.desc: Rookie co-pilot David faces a remote Arctic airstrip with sketchy landing gear. Mikey drafts a Buffalo hockey team to face off against an NHL squad in a charity shootout. Chuck gets a chance to shine on the ice.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Snowplane
programme.desc: Joe races a quirky antique snowmobile - with an airplane engine and no brakes. The water bomber crew struggles to get two planes out of Turkey. Cocky rampie Chris Staples tries to prove himself in the C-46.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Gear Lock
programme.desc: A cold snap triggers massive challenges. Devan runs into gear problems while he ferries a mothballed DC-3 across the country. And Justin has to make a snap decision with his newborn son aboard his plane.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Aussie Ace
programme.desc: The Electra returns from repairs and the crew takes it right back to the ice strip that it set off from before the crash landing last year. Tyler works up the courage to confront Joe about a big decision. A hotshot Australian pilot tries to earn a job.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Rock Stars and Rampies
programme.desc: Facing Joe's wrath, Rod and Cory head to the UK to make urgent water bomber repairs. David tries to prove himself to Devan in the C-46 but ends up infuriating Devan. Will makes an ultimatum in Hay River.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Ice Camp
programme.desc: Mikey trains for High Arctic survival with the Canadian Rangers. The Air Force invades Chuck's hangar. Joe faces tough competition at a California plane auction.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Frozen Solid
programme.desc: AJ and James battle a DC-4 engine fire. It's Joe's 69th birthday - and he's never flown a helicopter before, so Mikey plans a special gift of chopper flight lessons.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Power Crash
programme.desc: Cory, Chuck and Brian watch as a 5,000-pound power unit smash to the ground, denting the Electra and putting it out of commission. Mikey scrambles to manage the crisis while Joe races to England to try and purchase a backup Electra.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Breakdown
programme.desc: Co-pilot Graeme's fumbles his Electra training landings. Chris stresses over his C-46 check ride. Adam rescues a stranded C-46.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Target Practice
programme.desc: Joe and Mikey head to England to bring home a new plane. Devan does target-practice in the DC-4.James builds a Buffalo-style soapbox racer.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Air Show
programme.desc: Joe flies with the Snowbirds during the Hamilton air show and later teaches Mikey to fly. A surprise departure shakes up Buffalo.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Five Seasons
programme.desc: Ice Pilots NWT celebrates a milestone with a look back at the last five years, a peek behind the camera and reflections from the Buffalo crew.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: A Ball O'Snags
programme.desc: An engine fire and series of mechanical gremlins has Buffalo scrambling to make its Christmas deliveries. Newest rampie Prefkar Mony struggles with life in the North.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Ice Storm
programme.desc: Buffalo's Electra aircraft is hammered by rough winds up the Mackenzie Valley. In Hay River, a rookie crew faces the worst ice storm in years and one rampie has a tough go trying to fit in at Buffalo.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Old Dogs
programme.desc: Engine trouble plagues Buffalo's newest Electra, ZFE, and a standoff between Joe and Transport Canada threatens to close the airline. At the same time, Joe faces a tough decision about his old dog Sophie.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Checkflight
programme.desc: Joe leaves to undergo medical tests at the Mayo Clinic in Phoenix, Arizona. Jeff and Sam stress over their DC-3 checkflights and Joe celebrates turning 70-his way.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Second Chances
programme.desc: Rookie pilot Jeff nearly runs off the runway. Prefkar learns to play hockey but drops the ball at Buffalo and Joe goes on a date with a real dog.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Choo-Choo, Cha-Ching!
programme.desc: Ton and Allen get a surprise second chance after nearly getting shut out in the small town of Palmer. They uncover a motorized railroad maintenance car from the 1960's and a pre-WWI Japanese semi-automatic pistol.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Little-Ton Jones
programme.desc: Allen & Ton try to get the inside scoop on their competition by chatting up local auction buyers. The guys find some heavy gold-mining machinery from the 1950s & an amateur rocket that can travel faster than the speed of sound!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Big Easy Money
programme.desc: Allen & Ton head to New Orleans in search of easy money, but instead encounter some bayou bidders with big-time bucks! They discover a pair of early 19th-century dueling pistols & a vintage airboat fitted with a turbine engine!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Half Pipe Dreams
programme.desc: 1970s Z-Flex Jimmy Plumer Poolrider skateboard with artwork by Doug Smith; Kevlar bulletproof vest, ballistic facemask and a helmet used by S.W.A.T. teams; a pair of 1990s racing pocket bikes capable of going 80 mph.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Sink or Swim
programme.desc: 1905 Hand-crank Thomas Edison gramophone with cylindrical records; a discontinued Addictor 190 Mini Boat; a rare 1897 Regina music box.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Mr. Haff Goes to Washington
programme.desc: Ton and Allen invade the Nation's capital, but meet strong resistance from local bidders. The guys uncover a Civil War era black powder revolver and a stash of South African gold coins!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Smoking Ton
programme.desc: WW2 Stuart M3 tank barrel and heavy duty tank treads; rare, collectors' 1890 silver inlayed humidor; high-end industrial meat slicer in the ultimate restaurant unit.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Voodoo Moola
programme.desc: Allen & Ton hit a storage auction in Louisiana's Capitol City and quickly find themselves in trouble with the law! The guys uncover a pair of racing lawnmowers and then stumble on an antique barber chair from the early 1900s!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Diesel Digs
programme.desc: The guys head to the industrial hub of LA to score some heavy machinery and unearth a 1981 Bobcat 743 Frontloader, one of the first powered by a diesel engine and a trench-defending WWI German Sturmtrupp helmet bashing mace.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hidden Hot Wheels
programme.desc: Ton and Allen challenge a big time auction buyer on his home turf. The guys uncover a 1969 Chevelle Malibu muscle car and a single-shot pistol designed to aid Allied resistance fighters during WWII.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Real Thing
programme.desc: Allen and Ton compete with a notorious deep-pocketed bidder in Oxnard, CA, and score a vintage Coca-Cola vending machine, a vintage desk and a rare 1971 GMC truck.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: High Flying Ton
programme.desc: A nerdy auction buyer tests Ton and Allen's patience at a big container auction in Ventura. The guys discover a basket and burners for a hot air balloon and a 19th century German single shot rifle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Viva la Vegas
programme.desc: 1974 death-defying Zig Zag magic sword box, an ultra-rare 1910 poster of the infamous magician Chung Ling Soo, an 1800s naval cane sword and century-old Metlach German beer steins.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Driller Instinct
programme.desc: Ton & Allen encounter aggressive outdoorsmen in the Alaskan wilderness. The guys discover an 8-wheeled ATV that travels on both land & water and an air percussion hammer that can drill through solid rock!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Night of the Digging Dead
programme.desc: A custom-built shark cage; 1900s pathologist's dissection toolkit; 1940s embalming pump and one of the first electric bone saws.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Rodeo Ton
programme.desc: 1970s El Toro mechanical bull used to train bull riders; silver WWII era banjo; a collection of 1800s handcrafted hunting duck decoys.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Drumming Up Cash
programme.desc: Ton & Allen face some silent but deadly competition at an auction in nearby Glendale. They discover a Zildjian brand percussion cymbal from the 1940's and a pyrotechnics control board designed for large-scale fireworks displays!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Labor of Love
programme.desc: Harley Davidson V-twin EVO engine and revolutionary 1958 dual-suspension swingarm frame; '80s Ms. Pac-Man arcade machine; rare Air Jordan vintage shoe collection in mint condition.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Reel Money
programme.desc: 1970's-era Fighting Chair used for big-game fishing; military MILES "laser tag" training system.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Early Bird Special
programme.desc: Vintage Shooting Star carnival game; professional Mixed Martial Arts octagon fighting cage.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Animal Instincts
programme.desc: The first pump action shotgun - a Winchester Model 1897; a hunter's collection of prize big game, full-body taxidermy.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Miami Heat
programme.desc: All-terrain Air Commander Hovercraft, a 1970s NASA countdown clock and a one-of-a-kind 1960s Delta Relay rocket.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Gangster Whiskey
programme.desc: Allen and Ton trek to an auction in Moreno Valley, CA, where two locker wins yield a vintage jukebox, a valuable baseball card and a Prohibition-era moonshine still.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Money Makin' Monster Machines
programme.desc: The Auction Hunters team goes on the attack & ends up on a collision course with a hardened veteran auction buyer. They uncover a collection of speedy off-road vehicles and some hardcore heavy metal from the turn-of the-century!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Knuckle Dust
programme.desc: 1870s French Jarre Dolne Knuckle Duster revolver-knife-brass knuckle combo, a rare original George Rodrigue "Blue Dog" screenprint and a 1980 autographed Raging Bull movie poster.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Everything's Bigger in Texas
programme.desc: Winchester 1886 rifle invented to kill buffalo; collection of 1950s electric Slot Cars.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Auction Hunters, Ink.
programme.desc: Autographed 1960s Bob Shaw Swing Gate tattoo machine; Terry Ives competition 22hp chainsaw; six foot chainsaw-carved cedar bear.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Dead Aim
programme.desc: Ton & Allen face-off against an auction buyer with shady bidding tactics and even more questionable fashion sense. The guys find a custom-built monowheel & a rifle designed to ward off grave robbers in the early 19th century!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Strat'ed for Cash
programme.desc: On a limited budget in the historic L.A. neighborhood of West Adams, Allen and Ton still win three lockers and find a Maui Blue Fender Stratocaster and a 1930s Schwinn bike.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Chicago Grand Slam
programme.desc: 1984 Yamaha SS440 Snowmobile that introduced the revolutionary shock absorber suspension; rare autographed 1920s baseball glove; mint Hank Aaron signed baseball; authentic 1950s Robby the Robot collector toy.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Jersey Score
programme.desc: Ton & Allen attend a silent auction in NJ, but that doesn't stop the local buyers from letting them know they're not welcome! They uncover a skeet throwing machine from the 1960's & a vintage vehicle with some real horsepower!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hula Moola
programme.desc: Ton and Allen jet to the Hawaiian islands where they're joined by a feisty new female assistant! The team uncovers a pair of James Bond-style gadgets designed for high-speed underwater travel and a vintage sled.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Friends in Hawaii Places
programme.desc: Allen &Ton enlist an assistant, Carolyn, and Allen's Hawaiian buddy, Junior, to help them battle local buyers. The guys find a WWII-era motor scooter and a stash of antique Polynesian tattoo tools that get used on Ton!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Home on the Gun Range
programme.desc: Barely making it to an auction in Corona, CA, Allen and Ton buy an overstuffed unit and find an antique crossbow, a rare 10-gauge Winchester shotgun and a 1940s Kiss-o-Meter.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Chi-Town Showdown
programme.desc: Metal Victorian-era burial casket; 1870s glass fire extinguisher grenades; a mechanical 1896 handcrafted Chicago fire station alarm box.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Quadzilla Attacks!
programme.desc: Extreme Quadzilla ATV, the fastest 4 wheeler ever; a 1910s Remington Derringer and an 1880s Palm Squeezer pistol; revolutionary 1800s Western Electric telephone with a crank dial.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Gangs of New York
programme.desc: Ton and Allen duke it out with a local thrift store gang at a Brooklyn storage auction. The guys discover a classic arcade redemption game and a mid-century water cannon designed to fight towering infernos!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hot Wheels

programme.desc: Rob, Steelo og Chanel viser sinnssykt morsomme Redneck Good Times, Nutflix og Double Whammies. Ryan O'Malley, hoppestokkmester, viser frem sportens gode og dårlige sider, og du får se hvorfor du aldri bør snu ryggen til en lama!

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Johnny Knoxville
programme.desc: Johnny Knoxville hjelper Rob med å presentere Makeshift Ramps, Freak Beasts og Poorly Placed Kid, og du får vite hvorfor fugler aldri er dine venner, spesielt ikke om de har nebb lange nok til å nå hjernen din gjennom nesa!

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Big Black
programme.desc: Robs tidligere medspiller Big Black slutter seg til panelet og ser på Makeshift Thrill Rides, Bieber Hair og Coming in Hot. Se hvordan menneske-skorpioner stikker på en helt annen måte enn edderkoppen som angriper en uskyldig far.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Travis Pastrana
programme.desc: Motorsportsstjernen Travis Pastrana hjelper Rob med å presentere Poorly Placed Trees og Whiskey Throttles. Rob viser deg Pastranabees og Animals Being Human, og du får sjansen til å eksplodere av latter av Butt Bottle Rocket.

programme.title: Teen Mom
programme.desc: Farrah tilkaller politiet etter en heftig krangel med moren. Amber lurer på om hun er gravid, og dermed kan glemme å fullføre skolegangen. Maci saksøker Ryan for å få barnebidrag, og Catelynn må flytte ut av huset til kjæresten Tyler.

programme.title: Teen Mom
programme.desc: Catelynn risikerer å miste kjæresten, mens Ambers kjæreste sier at han kanskje vil forlate henne. Farrah balanserer college, ny jobb, og å bo alene med datteren. Maci innser at hun ikke kan bo sammen med både venner og babyen.
programme.sub-title: Should I Stay or Should I Go?

programme.title: Teen Mom
programme.desc: Maci går ut med jentene og møter en gammel flamme. Babygråt og urealistiske forventninger ødelegger Amber og Garys romantiske middag. Tyler har dårlig samvittighet etter adopsjonen, og Farrah avslører en hemmelighet om barnefaren.

programme.title: The Hills: New City, New Drama
programme.desc: Når Lauren Conrad må mestre både moteskolen, en krevende praktikantjobb og en uforutsigbar romkamerat som ødelegger for henne, forstår hun raskt at alt er stort i Los Angeles, også hennes egne problemer.

programme.title: The Hills: A Change of Plans
programme.desc: Når Heidi fikser et intervju for drømmejobben som får henne til å overveie å hoppe av skolen permanent, forstår Lauren at hun og Heidi kanskje har helt forskjellige mål.

programme.title: The Hills: An Unexpected Call
programme.desc: Teen Vogue sender Lauren på et oppdrag til New York City, men vel tilbake i L.A. venter det henne en stor overraskelse fra fortiden. Heidi skjønner at å jobbe med festreklamering ikke bare er en fest.

programme.title: The Hills: Lauren and Jason: Part 2
programme.desc: Da Jason, Laurens eksflamme fra Laguna Beach, dukker opp igjen i livet hennes, forstår hun at hun kanskje ikke er så ferdig med ham som hun trodde. Samtidig, i sin nye jobb, spør Heidi seg om det egentlig er verdt alt strevet.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Fade to Black
programme.desc: Paulie og Mike må sjonglere flere grupper med jenter. Det blir slåsskamp i baren, og en av deltakerne blir slått ned.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Just Another Day at the Shore
programme.desc: Med støtte fra de fleste av de andre er Snooki på bedringens vei. Ronnies familie kommer på besøk, og Sammi ønsker å gjøre et godt førsteinntrykk. JWoww blir lei folkene i klubben og havner i slåsskamp.
programme.sub-title: Just Another Day at the Shore

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Boardwalk Blowups
programme.desc: Mike ber jenter til huset, og situasjonen kommer ut av kontroll. Snooki havner i slåsskamp igjen. Ronnie havner også i bråk, og Sammi begynner å tvile på forholdet deres.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Redemption Song
programme.desc: A report on the 1985 death of Natalie Antonetti, a woman who was part of the Austin, Texas music community. She was found beaten at home by her son, Johnny Goodie, and remained in a coma for two weeks before she died.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Vase Against Enrico Forti
programme.desc: 48 Hours is television's most popular true-crime series, investigating shocking cases and compelling real-life dramas with journalistic integrity and cutting-edge style.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Red Notice For Murder
programme.desc: A report on the international search conducted by Nadia Ford and private detective Herman Weisberg for Viktoria Nasyrova, a Russian woman suspected of the 2014 murder of Ford's mother, Alla Aleksenko.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Click for a Killer
programme.desc: Part two of a two-part report on the alarming world of murder-for-hire on the mysterious "dark web," exposes an international criminal organization in a hunt for a self-described murder mastermind named Yura.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Death on Valentine's Day
programme.desc: 48 Hours is television's most popular true-crime series, investigating shocking cases and compelling real-life dramas with journalistic integrity and cutting-edge style.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Stalked: Out of the Shadows - Part 1
programme.desc: A two-part investigation into stalking -- the victims, the stalkers, the dangers and the long-term psychological damage this torment causes. Includes a report on the stalking death of singer Christina Grimmie.
programme.sub-title: Stalked: Out of the Shadows - Part 1

programme.title: 48 Hours: Last Chance for Freedom
programme.desc: A report on Crosley Green, who in 1990 was convicted of the murder of Charles "Chip" Flynn and sentenced to death. Green has spent the last 26 years, with help from lawyers and private investigators, trying to prove his innocence.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Murder in the O.C.
programme.desc: A report on the 1994 murder of millionaire businessman Bill McLaughlin in his California home. After his divorce, he became involved with the much younger Nanette Johnston, who it was later discovered, made a habit of seeking out wealthy men to date.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Dangerous Beauty
programme.desc: A report on the 2003 murder of Russel Douglas on Whidbey Island, Washington, and how the investigation led to the involvement of Peggy Sue Thomas, a one-time Washington beauty queen-turned-high-end limo driver.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Drawn to Murder - Part 1
programme.desc: A two-part report on the February 1987 murder of 37-year-old Peggy Hettrick in Fort Collins, Colorado. Her mutilated, half-naked body was discovered in a field near the home of Tim Masters, a 15-year-old who lived near the crime scene.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Facebook Detectives
programme.desc: A report about three Texas housewives, Tammye Markle, Joni Shannon, and Tina Wiley, who call themselves the "Facebook Detectives" and who used the Internet to try to find their friend Lisa Stone, who disappeared from her Dallas home in June 2010.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Case Against Michael Politte
programme.desc: 48 Hours is television's most popular true-crime series, investigating shocking cases and compelling real-life dramas with journalistic integrity and cutting-edge style.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The McGuire Diaries
programme.desc: In May of 2004, Bill McGuire’s dismembered body was found in three suitcases in Chesapeake Bay. He had been shot with a .38 caliber gun. His wife Melanie claimed that Bill had vanished weeks before, after an argument.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Love and Death in Alaska - Part 2
programme.desc: On May 2, 1996, the body of Kent Leppink was found off a deserted road in Alaska. He had been shot three times. Police discovered that he had been involved with Mechele Hughes, a young woman who worked as a stripper in a club.
programme.sub-title: Love and Death in Alaska - Part 2

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Phantoms
programme.desc: To fight an aging dictator's purge of young artists, an IMF member (guest star Antoinette Bower) becomes a ghost and Paris assumes the guise of a man long dead on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Lover's Knot
programme.desc: In the midst of delicate operations to identify the chief of an espionage ring, Jim Phelps realizes that Paris has fallen in love with an enemy agent on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Orpheus
programme.desc: Jim Phelps assumes a risky pose as a drug addict with information to sell to get behind the Iron Curtain where he seeks to stop an unknown assassin from killing an unknown victim on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Choice
programme.desc: Paris is marked for execution when he impersonates a power-mad mystic trying to win control of a friendly country by hypnotizing its woman ruler on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Crane
programme.desc: After rescuing a prisoner from execution by a dictator (guest star Carl Betz), the IMF has to find a hiding place so conspicuous it will be overlooked by police hunting the fugitive on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Death Squad
programme.desc: Jim Phelps leads the IMF to aid one of its own members when Barney is arrested and marked for execution by a sadistic police chief (guest star Pernell Roberts) on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Martyr
programme.desc: To keep a student congress from being used as a rubber stamp by a repressive premier (John Larch), the IMF sets Phelps up for capture so he can betray Paris as a turncoat student leader on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Butterfly
programme.desc: The IMF attempts to clear an American businessman in Japan of false charges that he murdered his Japanese wife in "Butterfly," a segment of Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible" series.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Contender, Pt. 1
programme.desc: The Impossible Missions Force is assigned to knock out a boxing syndicate which fixes fights to create favorable odds for a bookmaking operation, in the first half of a two-part story.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Contender, Pt. 2
programme.desc: Barney poses as a fighter making his comeback, who boxes his way to a title bout with Staczek (Robert Phillips) in the second half of a two-part episode.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Execution
programme.desc: Not knowing when, where, or how a dangerous adversary will strike, Jim Phelps and Cinnamon use themselves as human quarries.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Play
programme.desc: With Phelps and Rollin as the leading men, the Impossible Missions Force stages an anti-American play which could prove to be a strong propaganda device for the enemy.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Cardinal
programme.desc: An army commander (played by guest star Theodore Bikel) plots to become dictator by imprisoning an influential cardinal and using a look-alike actor for a public endorsement.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Elixir
programme.desc: The Impossible Missions Force offers a "fountain of youth" to the vain and dictatorial widow (guest star Ruth Roman) of the late president of a small South American country in order to depose her.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Exchange
programme.desc: Cinnamon is captured and the enemy discovers the one thing that would unmask her identity and expose the Impossible Mission Force.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Bargain
programme.desc: The former dictator of a Caribbean island is made to have hallucinatory visions in which he sees his ominous destiny as part of an ingenious plot designed by the Impossible Missions Force.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Mind of Stefan Miklos
programme.desc: The Impossible Missions Force is pitted against the ingenious logic of an enemy agent (guest Steve Ihnat) as the IMF attempts to lead the agent through a maze of complicated clues in order to reach a false conclusion.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Freeze
programme.desc: Before a statute of limitations expires on a 10-million dollar robbery, the Impossible Missions Force must spring the suspect from prison and dupe him into leading police to the hiding place of the money.

programme.title: While We're Young
programme.desc: While We're Young er Noah Baumbachs generasjonsoverskridende komedie om holdninger til aldring, ambisjon og suksess. Og dessuten et rørende portrett av et ekteskap som settes på prøve av ungdommens invaderende krefter.

programme.title: My Bakery in Brooklyn
programme.desc: Vivien og Chloe har nylig arvet sin tante Isabelles bakeri. Chloe ønsker å endre bakeriets utseende og meny, mens Vivien vil beholde alt slik det alltid har vært. Dette fører til en kamp om hvem som kan lokke til seg kunder på stadig mer kreative måter.

programme.title: The Deal
programme.desc: Det umake paret Charlie og Deidre bedrar alt og alle, ikke minst hele Hollywood-maskineriet når de forsøker å skaffe finansiering til en film. Charlie endrer manuset fra en intellektuell sovepille til en fargesprakende actionfilm..

programme.title: The Cooler
programme.desc: Den uheldige Bernie Lootz er en beryktet spiller med gjeld på de fleste kasinoene i Las Vegas. For å kunne betale ned sin enorme spillegjeld, blir han tvunget til å jobbe for den hensynsløse kasinomeieren Shelly Kaplow.

programme.title: Superhost
programme.desc: Bloggere Teddy og Claire reiser rundt og vurderer feriehus og kritikken deres veier mye hos fansen. Tomten begynner å føles utvannet og den trenger noe nytt og huset til Rebecka i skogen virker perfekt for formålet. De kunne ikke tatt mer feil...

programme.title: Modern Persuasion
programme.desc: En singel kvinne med fokus på karrieren i New York blir tvunget til å forholde seg til følgene av et mislykket forhold når ekskjæresten hennes hyrer inn hennes reklamebyrå.

programme.title: Tamara Drewe
programme.desc: Den unge journalisten Tamara Drewe vender tilbake til sine røtter på den engelske landsbygda for å selge sitt barndomshjem etter at hennes mor dør. Hennes ankomst skaper mildt sagt en hel del uro i byen.

programme.title: Burying The Ex
programme.desc: Max er en veldig hyggelig fyr. Hans søte kjæreste Evelyn viser seg å være et kontrollerende og manipulerende mareritt så snart de flytter sammen. Max vet det er på tide å gjøre det slutt, men er livredd for å slå opp med henne.

programme.title: All For Her
programme.desc: Devina og ektemannen Rick lengter etter barn. Etter år med spontanaborter blir Devina endelig gravid. Men det viser seg at hun lider av en dødelig sykdom. Nå begynner en kamp mot klokken, Devina må overleve til barnet er født...

programme.title: Watching the Detectives
programme.desc: Neil er en skikkelig filmfrik som eier en liten videobutikk. Når han ikke sitter som naglet fast foran fjernsynsapparatet og en eller annen film noir, diskuterer han film med de to medarbeiderne sine, supernerden Lucien og den noe mer stabile Jonathan.

programme.title: Scream 4
programme.desc: 10 år har gått og Sydney har endelig begynt å få livet sitt tilbake. Men det varer ikke særlig mye lenger, og i dette tiåret er det nye regler som gjelder.

programme.title: It Comes At Night
programme.desc: I et avsidesliggende hus lever Travis trygt med foreldrene, men han må håndtere frykt og paranoia når et ungt par søker tilflukt hos familien. Selv med de beste hensikter tar panikken overhånd når omverdenens skrekk og gru kommer stadig nærmere.

programme.title: Leatherface

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 603

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 402
programme.desc: Ekspertene drar til Hørning, der presten og hennes familie trenger et nytt sted å bo. De leier et lite rekkehus og nå vil de gjerne flytte.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 404
programme.desc: Ida og Rasmus drømmer om å bytte ut sine lille leiebolig på Nørrebro med en murervilla i Hillerød. Men de angrer bittert på at de har spurt ekspertene om hjelp når de får se huset pengene gikk til.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Central Jutland
programme.desc: Volcanoes and glaciers shaped this part of the country, leaving a giant fjord and pre-historic fossils in their wake. Farmers and food innovators work closely with nature to prepare food with the area’s plentiful herbs and award-winning seafood.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Tareq goes back to Åland to explore more of this island territory. Tareq finds a chef setting up a huge food village, sees forts left over from various invaders over the centuries, and learns about beer being recreated from 200 year old DNA.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Tornedalen
programme.desc: There are not many places like Tornedalen. A rushing river has provided for locals for centuries, and the very fertile land has yielded amazing crops for centuries.Tareq explores the traditions and the food that are part of the short summer season.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Jutland
programme.desc: At the northern-most part of Denmark, you are always close to raw, beautiful nature, and incredible sunlight that has drawn artists here for over 100 years. Tareq visits a salt maker using medieval techniques and experiences the magic light of Skagen.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: East Denmark
programme.desc: East Denmark contains some of Denmark’s most fertile lands, and many traditional farmers are converting to organic production and winning awards for their cheeses and wine. Tareq bikes through an area of limestone cliffs and Viking ships.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kristianstad
programme.desc: Located in Sweden’s south, beautiful Kristianstad is a 400-year old town surrounded by the ocean, fertile farmland and protected wetlands to aid the environment. Tareq makes his own chocolate and learns all about the art of eel-fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Southwest Jutland
programme.desc: Tareq visits Sydvestjylland – a unique area in Denmark filled with endless contrasts. Many food innovators are using the surrounding environment to take old traditions and apply them to the 21st century.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Nynäshamn
programme.desc: Sunny Nynäshamn is a resort town close to Stockholm, but there is more here than the sea. Tareq meets a prize-winning chocolate maker using ingredients from her garden, visits a thriving local food market, and gets a lesson in how to smoke fish.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Røros
programme.desc: Born as a mining town in the 17th century, Røros is now a center for local and organic food producers. Tareq tries dairy products which Michelin-starred chefs swear by, goes skiing and sledding around Røros many hilly streets

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Vimmerby
programme.desc: Vimmerby is known as the birthplace of beloved author Astrid Lindgren. Tareq finds that the area is also well-regarded for its cuisine. From the children’s theme park to the friendly moose that roam the hills, Vimmerby has a lot to offer visitors.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Trysil
programme.desc: The mountains and snowfall in Trysil mean that the town has to be creative with food; Tareq learns how to make cheese in the traditional way, and goes skiing of course, and takes to the slopes to cook something as skiers pass by.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Värmland
programme.desc: Värmland is home to many of Sweden’s most famous authors and inventors. However, it is also a place with a rich food culture. Tareq gets his hands on a very rare bird to cook and also takes time out to float down a tranquil river on a wooden raft.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Fyn
programme.desc: Tareq visits Fyn, the fairy tale capital of the world. Famous as the birthplace of Hans Christian Andersen, Fyn is also known as the garden of Denmark. Here we explore stunning nature and world class cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höga Kusten
programme.desc: Created thousands of years ago, the High Coast in the northern part of Sweden is the highest coast in the world. Tareq sets out to sample one of the most extreme types of Swedish food, fermented herring.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Denmark
programme.desc: North Jutland has a rich culinary history. The unique conditions have created equally unique products. Tareq meets local food entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever changing environment and putting this region on the culinary map.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Uppsala
programme.desc: Uppsala is the city of knowledge: home to the oldest university in Scandinavia. It’s a wonderful agricultural area surrounded by fertile flatlands. Tareq discovers the historical treasures of Uppsala and its thriving culinary life.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Sealand
programme.desc: North Zealand has been a playground of the rich and famous since the fifteenth century. Tareq learns how this beautiful north eastern part of Denmark is the perfect place to go foraging for wild berries and herbs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åre
programme.desc: Sweden’s largest ski resort Åre is well known for its local ingredients, boasting the highest number of organic food producers per capita in Sweden. The fresh water and clean air create unique conditions for growing excellent food.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Danish Lakelands
programme.desc: The Danish Lakelands produce some of the finest ingredients that you can find. Tareq has a go at an old cooking technique from New Zealand called Hangi - using heated rocks buried in a pit oven.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: West Sweden
programme.desc: Gothenburg on the west coast of Sweden has recently been discovered as an exciting destination by both international travel journalists and food bloggers. Tareq tracks down an old army barracks which has been converted into a world class cheese factory.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Luleå
programme.desc: Tareq visits Luleå, home to the beautiful Tree Hotel: a collection of treehouses built by an award winning architect. Following the river further up into the mountains he reaches the land where, for centuries, the Sami people kept their reindeer herds.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Halmstad
programme.desc: In Halmstad Tareq explores the contrast between the busy summer scene at the beach and the quiet rural country life, meeting Jörgen Persson: award winning table tennis player and visiting a village famous for its cheese.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kemi
programme.desc: Kemi is situated in northern Finland by the Bothnian Bay and it is part of Lapland region. Tareq tries his luck at a spot of burbot fishing on the frozen sea and visits the snow castle hotel.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: West Sweden
programme.desc: Situated on the west coast of Sweden, Bohuslän is a place where you can really feel the history of fishing all around a tradition that is still active. Tareq will be harvesting supreme quality oysters and lobsters and cook some wonderful seafood dishes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Florø
programme.desc: Tareq visits Norway and Florø to celebrate their national day -17th of May. Surrounded by breathtaking archipelagos and stunning fjords he dives for scallops in the north sea, cooking at mountain peaks and exploring the history of norwegian salmon

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Estonia
programme.desc: Tareq makes his way across the baltic sea to Estonia and the capital Tallinn. He discovers the historical treasures of the city and its thriving culinary life before he heads out into the vast and beautiful countryside and the national park of Soomaa.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Ringkøbing
programme.desc: Ringkøbing, a lovely old market town located at the west coast of Denmark. Here, Tareq visit a traditional Herring Festival and meets up with local entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever-changing environment.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Falkenberg
programme.desc: Something is definitely happening in Falkenberg on the west coast of Sweden. Over the last couple of years it have become somewhat of a haven for foodies. Tareq is on a mission; taking him through a fertile landscape with vineyards and salmon fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Estonia (Part 2)
programme.desc: Estonia has embarked on a journey greatly inspired by the nordic cuisine. Tareq explores the countryside of Estonia before he returns to the capital of Tallinn where he meets people that really love their traditional food.

programme.desc: I kveldens episode møter vi fire ofre for plastiskkirurgiske feiloperasjoner.

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 501
programme.desc: Siden puberteten, har Tascha vært lei av sine asymmetriske bryster og har hatt en brystoperasjon. Men Tascha fikk ikke symmetrien hun drømte om, og i dag skammer hun seg over brystene.

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 805
programme.desc: Som tenåring har Linette en skjev skillevegg i nesen som gir henne pustevansker. Som 21-åring får hun derfor tilbud om en neseoperasjon for å fikse problemet, men ender opp med en skjev nese.
